title: USS Arizona Memorial
teaser:
The USS Arizona Memorial is the #1 visitor destination in Hawaiʻi. Millions of people from all over the world come to this majestic setting to see for themselves where World War II began for the United States on Dec 7, 1941. Come discover our recently renovated Pearl Harbor Visitor Center featuring two world-class museums, theaters, shoreline exhibits and panoramic views of Pearl Harbor.   
  
The National Park Service oversees the USS Arizona Memorial and the Pearl Visitor Center, open daily from 7 am to 5 pm.  
  
The boat program to the Memorial is from 8:00 am to 3:30 pm. Advance reservations are available two months out for just $1 per ticket on www.recreation.gov. A number of tickets can also be purchased the day before online at 3 pm Hawaiʻi Standard Time. These service fees are non-refundable. Walk-in tickets are no longer given out in the Visitor Center. The National Park Service manages a standby line for the boats and will allow visitors without a reservation to board when there is space available on the boat.   
  
Official USS Arizona Memorial Narrated Multimedia and Virtual Reality Tours from basic to VIP Packages are available in English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Korean, and Mandarin and start from just $7.99. For reservations, please visit ussarizonatours.com to book tours or call 1-866-332-1941.

title: Diamond Head Visitor Center
teaser:
The Diamond Head Visitor Center is a partnership between the State Park Division and Pacific Historic Parks. Open from 7 am to 3:30 pm and is located within the Diamond Head crater at the beginning of the hiking trail. The park is closed on Dec 24th, Dec 25, and Jan 1st.  
  
The Diamond Head Visitor Center is the only location in Hawaii that offers the public the official State of Hawaii Diamond Head logo merchandise. It is also the only location that offers the official State of Hawaii Diamond Head State Monument Tours and the official “I Hiked Diamond Head” certificates.  
  
The Diamond Head Visitor Center Tours are available from 7 am to 2 pm, with the Visitor Center closing at 3:30 pm. The official State of Hawaii Diamond Head tours are available in English, Japanese, Spanish, French, German, Mandarin, Hawaiian and Korean. For reservations, please visit PacificHistoricParks.org, email Tours@PacificHistoricParks.org or call toll-free 1-866-332-1941.  
  
DIAMOND HEAD STATE MONUMENT - As of May 2022, all out-of-state visitors must have an advanced reservation to enter Diamond Head State Monument. Hawaiʻi residents continue to enjoy free access without reservations, but entry may depend on parking availability. Commercial tour and trolley patrons must have a reservation.

title: Kahanu Garden
teaser: On the rugged Hana coast, along the far eastern shores of the Hawaiian Island of Maui, Kahanu Garden grows in splendid isolation, nestled in the one of the largest native hala (Pandanus) forest in the Islands. Plant collections from the Pacific Islands are the focus here, particularly plants of value to the Hawaiian people as well as other cultures of Polynesia, Micronesia, and Melanesia. Kahanu Garden is situated in the storied land of Honoma'ele and home to Pi'ilanihale Heiau, a massive lava-rock structure that is believed to be the largest ancient man-made structure in Polynesia. Ths awe-inspiring cultural site in the garden is registered as a National Historic Landmark. Visitors to Kahanu Garden will learn about the cultural relationships between people and these remarkable plants that were transported around the Pacific on ancient voyaging canoes. Among the different ethnobotanical collections at Kahanu Garden is the world's largest collection of breadfruit cultivars, which serves as a germplasm repository for this important South Pacific food crop.

Limahui Garden is a Pu'uhonua (Place of Refuge) for an ecological system that honors the connection between nature and humanity, where indigenous traditions live in the 21st century. At Limhui NTBG adapts ancestral resources management practices to address contemporary conservation challenges and restore health, function, and resilience to the valley. title: Kona Snorkel Trips
teaser:
HAWAII'S HIGHEST-RATED & MOST REVIEWED SNORKEL COMPANY  
  
USE PROMO CODE XIA4Z6B4VQ0G21N5P72LA7UDG to receive $15 off your first booking  
  
Offering morning snorkel trips to Captain Cook Monument, afternoon snorkels in gorgeous Pawai Bay, and two different times for the Kona manta ray night snorkel. We operate from Kona's Honokohau Marina.  
  
The Big Island of Hawaii is home to some of the most breathtaking underwater ecosystems in the world, and Kona Snorkel Trips offers an unparalleled way to experience them. Based on the island’s sunny west coast, this premier snorkeling company takes adventurers on unforgettable ocean excursions, offering the chance to swim alongside vibrant coral reefs, playful dolphins, and majestic manta rays.  
  
With their expertly guided Kona Snorkel Tours, guests board a state-of-the-art vessel and cruise along the rugged Kona coastline, where black lava rock cliffs meet the deep blue Pacific. The combination of warm waters, crystal-clear visibility, and abundant marine life makes every journey a once-in-a-lifetime experience.  
  
  
The Journey: A Boat Ride Along the Stunning Kona Coastline  
  
As you step onto the deck of the sleek, well-equipped boat, you’re greeted by a warm, experienced crew eager to introduce you to the wonders of Hawaii’s underwater world. The Kona Snorkel Trips team provides a detailed briefing, ensuring everyone is comfortable, safe, and ready for adventure.  
  
The boat motors out of Honokohau Harbor, leaving behind the marina’s calm waters and heading south along the dramatic Kona coastline. The ride is exhilarating as the boat skims across the ocean, passing towering sea cliffs, hidden lava tubes, and ancient Hawaiian fishing villages. With no rivers feeding into the sea along this part of the island, the waters remain exceptionally clear—often offering over 100 feet of visibility.  
  
The landscape is a mesmerizing mix of jagged lava formations and lush tropical vegetation, with occasional glimpses of green sea turtles basking on rocky outcrops. Along the way, your guides share fascinating stories about the island’s volcanic history, local legends, and the marine life you’re about to encounter.  
  
Dolphins often join the journey, riding the boat’s wake and leaping into the air in playful displays. During the winter months, humpback whales migrate through these waters, and seeing one breach the surface is an unforgettable sight.  
  
Each of Kona Snorkel Trips’ tours offers a unique opportunity to explore the wonders of the Kona coast.  
  
  
Captain Cook Monument Snorkel Tour: A Journey Through History and Nature  
  
One of the most popular Kona Snorkel Tours takes guests to the world-renowned Kealakekua Bay, home to the historic Captain Cook Monument. This protected marine sanctuary is famous for its pristine coral reefs and abundance of tropical fish.  
  
As the boat anchors in the bay’s crystal-clear waters, guests are given high-quality snorkeling gear before plunging into the warm ocean. The first thing you notice is the sheer diversity of marine life—schools of yellow tang, butterflyfish, and parrotfish dart through the coral formations. If you’re lucky, you might even spot a moray eel or an octopus camouflaged against the reef.  
  
The bay is also known for its friendly spinner dolphins, which sometimes glide gracefully past snorkelers. While touching wildlife is strictly prohibited, simply observing these intelligent creatures in their natural habitat is a breathtaking experience.  
  
After plenty of time exploring the underwater world, guests climb back aboard to enjoy fresh tropical fruit and refreshments while taking in the stunning scenery of Kealakekua Bay.  
  
  
Manta Ray Night Snorkel: A Magical Encounter  
  
No trip with Kona Snorkel Trips is complete without experiencing the famous Manta Ray Night Snorkel—one of the most unforgettable Kona Snorkel Tours available.  
  
As the sun sets over the Pacific, the boat makes its way to Manta Ray Village, a renowned gathering spot for these gentle giants. With lights illuminating the water, guests slip into the ocean, holding onto a specially designed floating raft.  
  
Then, the magic begins. Enormous manta rays, some with wingspans of up to 15 feet, glide effortlessly beneath you, performing elegant barrel rolls as they feed on microscopic plankton. These creatures have no teeth, stingers, or barbs, making them completely harmless to humans. Watching them move in such close proximity is a thrilling yet serene experience, as their ghostly silhouettes dance through the illuminated water.  
  
Many guests describe this encounter as spiritual, a moment of pure connection with nature. After 30-40 minutes in the water, guests return to the boat, still in awe of what they just witnessed.  
  
  
Dolphin Watch & Reef Snorkel Adventure: Playful Encounters  
  
For those who dream of seeing dolphins in the wild, the Dolphin Watch & Reef Snorkel Adventure is the perfect choice. Kona Snorkel Trips follows responsible dolphin-watching guidelines, ensuring that these beautiful creatures are observed in a way that does not disturb their natural behavior.  
  
The journey takes guests to areas where pods of Hawaiian spinner dolphins are often spotted. These playful marine mammals love to ride the waves and sometimes perform spectacular aerial spins. Watching them leap out of the water against the backdrop of the lava-lined Kona coast is a sight to behold.  
  
After dolphin watching, the boat heads to a secluded reef for snorkeling. Here, the underwater world bursts to life with colorful coral gardens, bright reef fish, and occasional sightings of Hawaiian green sea turtles gliding through the water.  
  
This tour offers the perfect mix of excitement and relaxation, with plenty of time to soak in the beauty of the ocean.  
  
  
Private Snorkel Charters: A Personalized Ocean Adventure  
  
For those seeking an exclusive experience, Kona Snorkel Trips offers private snorkel charters, where guests can customize their own ocean adventure. Whether it’s a romantic sunset cruise, a family snorkeling day, or a photography expedition, these charters provide a tailor-made experience with a dedicated crew.  
  
Guests can choose from a variety of locations along the Kona coast, including remote snorkeling spots that few visitors ever get to see. With personalized service, gourmet snacks, and flexible itineraries, a private charter is the ultimate way to experience the best of Kona’s marine world.  
  
  
Why Choose Kona Snorkel Trips?  
  
With so many Kona snorkeling tours available in Hawaii, Kona Snorkel Trips stands out for its exceptional service, knowledgeable guides, and commitment to ocean conservation. Their boats are comfortable and well-equipped, ensuring a safe and enjoyable journey for all guests.  
  
Each tour includes high-quality snorkeling gear, flotation devices for those who need extra support, and refreshments to keep guests energized. The crew is passionate about marine life and dedicated to providing an educational, fun, and eco-friendly snorkeling experience.  
  
By choosing Kona Snorkel Tours, guests are not only embarking on an adventure—they are also supporting a company that values sustainability and marine conservation.  
  
Conclusion: A Snorkeling Experience Like No Other  
  
A day with Kona Snorkel Trips is more than just a snorkeling tour—it’s an opportunity to explore one of the most biodiverse marine environments on the planet, witness incredible wildlife, and create memories that will last a lifetime.  
  
From the thrill of riding along the rugged Kona coastline to the serenity of floating beside a majestic manta ray, every moment on the water is filled with wonder. Whether you’re an experienced snorkeler or a first-time visitor, Kona Snorkel Tours offers the perfect adventure to experience the beauty and magic of Hawaii’s underwater world.  
  
Book your trip today and dive into an unforgettable ocean adventure with Kona Snorkel Trips!

title: Sea Paradise Sailing & Snorkeling Tours
teaser:
Sea Paradise Hawaii has operated ocean tours from Keauhou Bay on the Kona Coast of the Island of Hawaiʻi since 1985. Owner Rich Kersten pioneered the large-vessel, large-group manta ray snorkel tour format —  
opening an experience that had previously been limited to small dive groups. He also designed the Manta Flotation Device used on every manta tour.  
  
Five tours depart from Keauhou Bay aboard the Hoku Nui, our 50-foot luxury sailing catamaran, capped at 49 guests: Morning Snorkel Tour (Captain Cook Monument at Kealakekua Bay Marine Life Conservation District + Red Hill lava arches, breakfast and lunch included), Afternoon Snorkel Tour (Captain Cook Monument at Kealakekua Bay, light snacks), 1st Manta Ray Night Tour (Manta Village, sunset departure), 2nd Manta Ray Night Tour (Manta Village, later evening), and our newest experience—Kona Sun, Sip & Sail (no snorkeling, handcrafted cocktails and pūpū, all ages).  
  
Our manta ray sighting rate averages 85–95% year-round at Manta Village. If manta rays are not seen on your tour night, return free within 7 days. Named resident mantas include Lefty (first identified in 1979), Big Bertha (first identified in 1991), Obama Ray, Koie Ray, Quarantina (2020), and Jolene Ray. Over 450 individual manta rays documented on the Kona Coast in partnership with Manta Pacific Research Foundation.  
  
Sea Paradise is Hawaii Ecotourism Association certified and sails to World Famous Captain Cook Monument in Kealakekua Bay Marine Life Conservation District. They use reef-safe sunscreen on every tour. 4.8 stars across 4,100+ reviews.

title: Friends of Kauai Wildlife Refuges
teaser:
Kilauea Point Natural History Association dba Friends of Kauai Wildlife Refuges is the non-profit Friends group that supports the work of the Kaua'i National Wildlife Refuge Complex. Our team operates the Visitor Center and Nature Store, and provides fundraising and outreach to support the mission of the refuge complex.  
  
VISITOR CENTER  
While visiting the Kilauea Point National Wildlife Refuge, we hope you will take the opportunity to visit us at the Visitor Center - featuring educational displays and videos to enhance your experience.   
  
NATURE STORE   
Within the Nature Store you will find a wide variety of quality educational products to help you understand the natural environment and natural history of the Kauai National Wildlife Refuge Complex, Kaua‘i and the Hawaiian Islands as a whole. All proceeds further the charitable mission of KPNHA - to support the Kaua'i National Wildlife Refuge Complex.   
  
ABOUT THE REFUGE  
The Kilauea Point National Wildlife Refuge is currently open Thursday – Saturday from 10:00 am to 4:00 pm, with closures on all major federal holidays. Peak visitation time is in the morning, please consider an alternative time to help facilitate a pleasant Refuge visit. Please give yourself at least 30 minutes to enjoy your time at the Refuge.   
  
An entry fee of $10 is required for adults 16 and older, and children under 16 are free. RESERVATIONS ARE REQUIRED. Visit: https://www.recreation.gov/ticket/facility/300018. All Federal Recreational Lands Passes are honored. Passes are available for purchase at the Refuge.  
  
Friends of Kauai Wildlife Refuges is the nonprofit Friends Group that supports the work of the Kauaʻi National Wildlife Refuge Complex, which includes refuges at Kīlauea Point, Hanalei and Hulēʻia. For information about other ways to support our Kauaʻi National Wildlife Refuges, please visit: http://www.kilaueapoint.org/

title: Blue Hawaiian Helicopters
teaser:
Founded in 1985, and honored by National Geographic as "Hawaii's premier helicopter tour company," Blue Hawaiian is also the only one that serves all of Hawaii—Oahu, Maui, Kauai, and the Big Island.   
  
Blue Hawaiian was the first in the industry to introduce the incredible EC130-B4 "Eco-Star," the world's first 21st-century touring helicopter. This phenomenal machine set a whole new standard in environmentally responsible air touring. It's significantly quieter and incorporates all the latest cutting-edge technologies, materials, systems, and avionics. Plus it offers incomparable passenger comfort, 23% more interior space, individual "First Class" seats, raised theatre-style platform in the rear, and far more cockpit glass for fantastic sweeping views. And now, Blue Hawaiian also owns the largest fleet of Eco-Star T2s, the latest and most advanced generation of Eco-Star.  
  
Blue Hawaiian continues to operate a select fleet of Eco-Stars—the industry standard in touring helicopters, all purchased new and meticulously maintained by Blue Hawaiian's FAA staff of top A&P; mechanics. This extraordinary team of professionals has been recognized every year since 1997 with the FAA’s ultimate accolade, the Certificate of Excellence – Diamond Award. No other helicopter tour company can match this record.  
  
And, every year since 1995, Blue Hawaiian has received the Six Star Diamond Award for Outstanding Quality and Service from the American Academy of Hospitality Sciences—the world’s only aerial tour company so honored.

title: Pacific Whale Foundation
teaser:
Pacific Whale Foundation is a nonprofit organization founded in 1980 to protect a declining humpback whale population from global threats, including commercial whaling. Early pioneers in noninvasive whale research, our scientists began offering educational whalewatches on the weekends, after studying whales and their ocean environment during the week. The trips were a means to share our findings, educate the public about whales, and raise needed funds for research and conservation work.  
  
That same tradition continues today. Our PacWhale Eco-Adventures cruise operation is 100% owned by the nonprofit Pacific Whale Foundation, as are our retail Ocean Stores. All profits go to supporting Pacific Whale Foundation’s work to protect the ocean through science and advocacy, and to inspire environmental stewardship.  
  
Your ticket to adventure on a PacWhale cruise directly funds Research, Education and Conservation programs on behalf of marine wildlife and their ocean home. Tours depart daily from Ma'alaea and Lahaina Harbors and private charters are available.   
Call 808-201-7409 or visit PacWhale.com.

Our core values are derived from the early beginnings of our company that started in Kauai, Hawaii. These values are centered around three principles: Aloha (love), Aina (land), and Ohana (family). At The Fresh Shave we believe the way food is prepared is just as important as how it is grown. Our product is handcrafted with aloha from start to finish. Being conscious of our land and choosing organic supports farmers and producers who live for the same things we do--good health and sustainable habits. Our family is our soul. We believe in the magic of building a supportive community. We ground our business in positive and productive interactions with colleagues, customers, and vendors.  
  
The Fresh Shave proves that dessert can taste delicious and make you feel good about your food choices at the same time. We plan to influence our food culture one Fresh Shave at a time!

teaser:

Zach Sato, Chef de Cuisine  
  
A Maui native with a fierce attraction to blending the best of culture and cuisine, Hotel Wailea’s chef de cuisine Zach Sato has cultivated an inimitable enthusiasm for showcasing Hawaii’s history and culture by working with generations of homegrown flavors, both present and past.  
  
Chef Sato brings to The Restaurant at Hotel Wailea a belief system derived in sourcing the finest available ingredients as a means of crafting exceptional cuisine. Chef Sato utilizes seasonal, island-grown offerings and ingredients from the hotel’s own farming operation, and has forged and fostered close relationships with Hawaii’s farmers and artisans – a favorite is the Big Island staple Hirabara Farms with which he works closely to craft season-driven dishes.  
  
“I aim to provide guests with not only a special dining experience but also a meal heightened with flavor fusions that are unexpected and executed perfectly,” said Chef Sato. “I take great care to ensure each dish is intentional and thoughtfully created around ingredients that are fresh and in season.”

title: Waikalua Loko I'a
teaser:
Aloha, E Komo Mai! Welcome to Waikalua Loko Fishpond, lovingly preserved and managed from 1995-2015 by Kia `I Loko (caretakers) at the Waikalua Loko Fishpond Preservation Society (WLFPS) and stewarded now by The Pacific American Foundation.   
  
For two decades, an intensive effort by students, community groups, public and private partners, and individual members of the greater community, breathed new life back into the 400 year old fishpond. As each stone was put back on the wall and each native plant took root, a foundation was laid for a healthier and sustainable future, honoring the rich cultural and natural heritage of the Kāne‘ohe ahupua’a.  
  
In 2016, the board of directors of the WLFPS declared their mission was successfully completed, and the fishpond was given to the Pacific American Foundation for future care and preservation.

Join the legendary Kauai Beach Boys aboard our new 50-foot catamaran on a scenic and relaxing sunset cruise of the historically significant areas of Kalapaki Bay, Nawiliwili, Haupu Mountain Range, Hulei’a River and Ninini Point. Drift away into the fading sun while sipping tropical cocktails and enjoy a pleasant evening tour with friends and family.  
  
Private Kauai Lagoons Sunset Cruise  
Romantic Sunset Cruises or Family Fishing & Sightseeing Tours on Kauai Lagoons. Cruise 35 acres of scenic fresh water lagoons and islands within a bird sanctuary where several endangered species of native birds reside. The waters are always calm and sunsets are often spectacular from our elevated vantage point 100’ above the ocean.  
  
Surf Lessons  
We’ve been teaching surfing since 1983 on Kauai’s best learning beach, Kalapaki Bay. Learn how to paddle and balance on your board and master the basics. We offer small classes, expert surf instructors, and the best gear including a board, leash and rash guard. With gentle trade winds and the protection of Kalapaki Bay, the surf is always up!  
  
Stand Up Paddle Board Lessons  
Stand-up paddling is the fastest growing sport in the water. We have top stand-up paddle boards that anybody can ride. Kalapaki’s sheltered bay is ideal for learning paddling basics and is Kauai’s premier SUP surf break.  
  
Thrilling Outrigger Canoe Ride  
Grab a paddle and join us for a traditional Hawaiian canoe ride. Double the fun with two of Hawaii’s favorite sports rolled into one! Paddle and surf Kalapaki Bay with an expert waterman skilled in the sport of Hawaiian outrigger canoe surfing. A truly original Hawaiian roller coaster ride!   
  
Kauai Beach Gear Rentals  
We offer rentals of everything you will need for an epic ocean-centered vacation. We have a variety of high quality gear including surfboards, paddle boards, boogie boards/fins, mask/snorkel/fins, kayaks, beach chairs and umbrellas that can be rented by the hour, day or week at our beach concession location at the Kauai Marriott in Lihue.

Explore the waterfalls your way with one of our bucket-list-worthy adventures! Choose between our adrenaline-pumping Waterfall Rappel tour or walk under a waterfall on our Waterfall Swim & Hike tour. Book today!

Snacks, water, and juice are provided throughout the tour. All gear, including harness, helmet, shoes, wetsuit top, and dry bag are included in the tour price.  
  
Join us today for an incredible Island adventure.

The aquarium is open daily, from 9 am to 5 pm. Visit mauioceancenter.com to reserve your tickets today.

title: Huliheʻe Palace
teaser:
The Daughters of Hawai‘i was founded in 1903 by seven progressive women ahead of their time. Born in Hawai‘i, they were citizens of the Hawaiian Kingdom before annexation and foresaw the inevitable loss of much of the Hawaiian culture. They founded the society “to perpetuate the memory and spirit of old Hawai‘i and of historic facts, and to preserve the nomenclature and correct pronunciation of the Hawaiian language.”  
  
Hulihe‘e Palace is located in historic Kailua-Kona on Ali‘i Drive. The Palace was originally built out of lava rock during the Kingdom of Hawai‘i on land known as Kalāke‘e, a former residence of Kamehameha the Great. The Palace itself was first home to High Chief John Adams Kuakini, brother of Ka‘ahumanu the favorite wife of Kamehameha, and later home to more members of Hawaiian royalty than any other residence in Hawai‘i. Hulihe‘e Palace consists of six large graciously appointed rooms, two large inviting oceanfront lanai and lovely grounds. Today Hulihe‘e is a museum showcasing artifacts from the era of King Kalākaua and Queen Kapi‘olani, featuring beautiful koa wood furniture, portraits, kapa, feather work, Hawaiian quilts and artifacts from Hawai‘i’s royal past.

teaser: At Maui Pacific Tours we offer one-of-a-kind private adventure in Maui that allow you to experience the best of Maui with a touch of luxury.

title: Hana and Beyond Tours
teaser:
Hana and Beyond is owned by local residents, who were born and raised in Hana, Maui. We offer a unique guided tour of that is considered East Maui. We adhere to all State and County mandates as well as the concerns of the residents of East Maui.   
  
Please visit our website for more information.

title: Road to Hana Tours
teaser:
Step on board with us at Road to Hana Tours and prepare to be swept away into the majestic beauty that is Hana. Our expert-guided tours will take you along the world-renowned Hana Highway, a journey that will both captivate and amaze with its 600 twists and turns, 50 historic bridges, and an endless display of lush jungle and rugged coastline.  
  
With two decades of experience under our belts, we take pride in our deep understanding of Hana's unique culture and natural wonders. Our knowledgeable guides are not merely drivers but storytellers, historians, and most importantly, friends. They take the time to share the stories and history of Hana, bringing you closer to the heart of the community. So, come make unforgettable memories with us on the Road to Hana. You won't regret it!

title: Volcano Tours
teaser:
Experience the raw power and beauty of nature with our volcano tours in Hawaii. Every journey immerses you in the geological wonder of our planet, offering awe-inspiring views of towering volcanic mountains and expansive lava fields that tell an incredible story. From the historical eruption site of Kilauea volcano to the grandeur of Mauna Loa, every tour promises a unique adventure that allows you to witness the stunning landscapes of Hawaii like never before.  
  
We provide a myriad of options to explore these spectacular sites. Soar over the majestic mountains in a helicopter, or feel the thrill of traversing the volcanic craters in a custom tour vehicle. For the more adventurous, our guided hiking tours offer an opportunity to go deep into the heart of Hawaii's volcanic history. With our expertly curated tours and knowledgeable local guides, you are guaranteed a memorable journey that captures the beauty and power of Hawaii's volcanoes.

title: Trade Shows Hawaii
teaser: Develop, produce and manage business-to-business trade shows and expositions as purchasing, sales and marketing venues for targeted industries and the markets they serve in the State of Hawaii.

title: Hanauma Bay Dive Tours
teaser:
Discover Hanauma Bay with Our Guided Snorkel Tour - Unforgettable Adventures Await!  
  
Indulge in the captivating world beneath the Hawaiian waves with our Hanauma Bay Guided Snorkel Tour - a favorite among visitors to Hawaii. At just $109.00 for both adults and children, our tour ensures an immersive experience, with high-quality sanitized dry snorkel equipment, safety snorkeling vests, beach mats, lock boxes, and convenient roundtrip transportation from all Waikiki hotels in our new air-conditioned vans.   
  
Our guided snorkel tours are led by scuba instructors and take small groups up to five people to the best areas in the bay to see turtles and schools of tropical fish. Great photo opportunities.  
  
Hanauma Bay Transportation & Gear Package  
Discover the freedom of exploring Hanauma Bay at your own pace with our all-inclusive unguided snorkel tour! Dive into the vibrant underwater world armed with top-notch gear provided as part of the package. Forget the hassle of transportation—we've got you covered with convenient pick-up and drop-off from Waikiki hotels.  
Prices: $50.99 for adults, $45.99 for children aged 12 and under. Beach chairs, wet suits and go pro camera rentals are available.  
  
Turtle Canyons Snorkel Excursion  
Discover the Waikiki Coast to Turtle Canyons snorkeling site at just USD$75.00! Spend approximately 2 hours immersed in the magic of sea turtles peacefully gliding above the vibrant reef, accompanied by playful reef fish. Experience the thrill as these turtles surface for air, offering an incredible sight for onlookers aboard the boat.   
  
🐬 Embark on the Ultimate Hawaii Dolphins Adventure! 🌊  
  
Discover the magic of the Hawaiian seas with our captivating Dolphins Adventure, an experience that promises an unforgettable encounter with the ocean's most enchanting inhabitants. Dive into a world of vibrant reefs, colorful fish, and the graceful Hawaii Green Sea Turtles.  
  
Tour Details:

Witness Spinner Dolphins in their natural environment.

title: Surfrider Foundation Kauai
teaser:
Surfrider Foundation Kauai is a non-profit environmental organization dedicated to the protection and enjoyment of the world’s oceans, waves and beaches for all people - through conservation, activism, research and education.   
  
Surfrider Kauai – joined by local community groups, Ohana and visitors – organizes regularly scheduled beach cleanups throughout the year. In 2020, we led 24 cleanups and together with our Net Patrol program, collected over 129,000 pounds of debris! Our strong, dedicated network of volunteers go out daily to clean the beaches. We pick up all plastic, nets, and trash from large stretches of beach – disposing it at the County landfill.

title: Lanai Car Rental
teaser: Lanai Car Rental is based on the island of Lanai and provides affordable and convenient rentals to tourists and locals alike. With a fleet of Jeep Wrangler Saharas, Chevy Bolts and Ford Transit Minivans, renters can find the perfect vehicle to meet their travel needs.

title: Whales and You
teaser:
View wild humpback whales and other diverse sea life in their natural habitat off of Oahu's stunning Gold Coast. Relax on our all-new double-decker boat with wrap-around bow seating in between whale sightings.  
  
We begin with a powerful Hawaiian plumeria flower ceremony and chant, "E Ho Mai" to bring us good fortune during our voyage. We'll also serve up some morning beverages and pastries. Then we will cruise along Oahu's windward coastline in search of humpback whales.  
  
As we begin to spot the whales, our crew will share information about their fascinating annual journey. If we are close enough, our crew will drop a hydrophone into the water to hear the whales' songs over our state-of-the-art sound system. Seeing whales up in person is an experience you will never forget!  
  
On the way back you'll be entertained by our amazing crew. They'll perform authentic hula dance and songs. Don’t miss an opportunity to see one of the world’s largest animals in person during their migration through Hawaii!

title: Sunset Luau at Kapalua Bay
teaser:
Welcome back to simpler times when Hawaiian celebrations were family Luau — festive dress, freshly gathered seafood, and prize dishes steamed in earthen ovens. Music, chant, hula and aloha regaled guests until stars glimmered high in the heavens. We invite you and your loved ones to Sunset Luau at Kapalua Bay.  
  
Let the island rhythms and swaying dancers whisk you away to another time.  
  
The evening begins with a complimentary Mai Tai or mocktail, and plenty of aloha. Throughout the evening, our mixologists will enthusiastically hand-craft island-inspired mocktails and cocktails to accompany your luau experience.  
  
While Maui’s own Manutea Nui E engages you in the songs, dance and lore of Hawai’i and Polynesia, our world-class Montage associates will serve you local delicacies, caught, grown and gathered on Maui. Our culinary team presents this Hawaiian-inspired cuisine with flair—kalo (taro), Molokai sweet potatoes (u`ala), and breadfruit (`ulu) served with fresh island catch, Hawaiian style poke, prawns, traditional kalua pork, and more. Your feast is individually-plated for your enjoyment, and we happily accommodate vegan requests.  
  
The SunsetLuau takes place every Tuesday and Thursday starting at 5:30 pm.

title: Elena's Estates and Vacation Rentals
teaser:
The enchanting view and light at Molokai Shores will make you happy you chose this condo for your vacation. But there are more attractions at the resort.   
  
Enjoy the pool on the ocean shore, play shuffleboard, or try your hand on the putting green (putters and balls, as well as snorkeling equipment provided in our condo). The tropical grounds are well kept and a pleasure to stroll through.   
  
Conveniently located benches allow you to relax on the ocean shore and watch the whales (in season) or cruise ships in the distance, and stunning sunsets.

Accommodations: Vacation Rentals

title: Big Island UFO Tours
teaser:
At Big Island UFO Tours, we introduce you to the unseen world with our advanced 3rd-generation military night vision goggles to witness for yourself, as well as the emerging remembrance of our galactic ancestors.   
  
You will learn about what is "known" (or identified) and how those objects behave, including satellites, planes, helicopters, and drones. Once you are trained in the "known," you will then be able to experience the "unknown" (or unidentified).   
  
We use state-of-the-art satellite tracking software to know exactly what satellites are flying overhead at any time, so there is no confusion about what is in the sky. Our guides talk story about their own personal experiences with UFOs and aliens.   
  
On the expanded spiritual tour, we lead you through a meditative journey to connect with your galactic family and guides and teach you how to raise your vibration to call in spacecraft.   
  
This is an experience you will not forget.

title: Hawaii Ocean Charters
teaser:
Hawaiʻi Ocean Charters offers private Waikīkī catamaran cruises to tourists and locals looking to have an ocean adventure without the crowd.   
  
Sunset cruises, guided snorkeling tours, whale and dolphin watching, coastal sightseeing, and firework shows are among the tours our guests love the most.   
  
From boat photoshoots and proposals to birthdays and memorials, we’re also able to accommodate a wide range of events on the water.

title: Disney Vacation Club
teaser: Along the beautiful shores of Oahu is Aulani, a Disney Resort & Spa, Ko Olina, Hawai`i: a stunning Resort where the magic of Disney meets the wonder of Hawai`i. As a Member of DISNEY VACATION CLUB you can experience all this Resort has to offer. At Aulani, you'll find unique entertainment for dreamers of every age. Families can enjoy breakfast with their favorite Disney pals. Kids can let their imaginations soar at Aunty's Beach house - a magical kids' club. Teens have their own freedom of experiences - like surfing - with programs designed just for them. And adults can escape to a relaxing spa or dine beachside at sunset. Plus, DISNEY VACATION CLUB accommodations include Deluxe Studios with kitchenette, or 1-, 2-, or 3-Bedroom Villas that provide separate living and bedroom spaces, full kitchen, in-unit laundry, DVD-player and whirlpool tub. You can enjoy these comforts of "home" with incredible ocean, poolside or island garden vistas that only Hawai`i can offer. HI-WEB-14-B.

Accommodations: Hotels and Resorts, Condominiums, Vacation Ownership

title: Hawaiian Adventures Kona
teaser:
Hawaiian Adventures Kona understands that first-hand experiences are key to cultivating connections between communities and wildlife. We hope that our tours can inspire this respect for marine life in those visiting Hawaii, a respect that the Kona community embodies. We are excited to be a part of a community that understands the health of our oceans is tantamount to our own well-being, and play our part to promote this mindset.   
  
Come join us on the water, and experience the connection with the whales that has inspired our family for the past 25 years.

title: Alaia
teaser: Our island is full of stories, none more inviting than the one told by the dish in front of you. Known for its modern take on Hawaiian comfort fare, Alaia embraces the community through its support of nearby Mauka Farms, telling their story through every plate, bite, and sip. Using unique, native produce such as bread fruit, apple bananas, and tomatoes from Pele, a third generation farmer, our culinary team works in tune with the seasons. We reap the island's bounty, working with hand-selected fruits and vegetables from our farm to your table​. We let the quality and simplicity of the ingredients speak for themselves.

title: Hoolana
teaser: The perfect cup of coffee, a thirst-quenching drink, local fruit fresh from Kuilima Farm. Get a fresh juice and a sandwich and holoholo—take it to go—for your hike through Waimea Valley. Enjoy fresh food, all day. The pick-me-up you need. E ʻAi Kākou, let’s eat!

title: Off The Lip
teaser: From fresh juice and homemade kombucha mock cocktails, Mai Tai making classes and bitters made in-house with herbs from Kuilima Farm. Where cocktails are made with fresh fruit and spirits as local as we can get and real Mai Tais are mixed up with housemade orgeat syrup. Where Kama'aina and visitors gather as friends for engaging live entertainment and the best tequila and rum cocktails on the island. As we say, Le'a ke kau 'ai, the time for food is pleasing. Let’s enjoy it together.

title: Sunset
teaser: The pools, the palms, the ocean, the breaks. Welcome to one of the most dramatic sunsets in all of Hawai‘i. Slide up to the bar in your swimsuit, order a tropical cocktail, and take it all in: the ocean, the pool, the surfers, the people. This is the place to see and be seen. Watch surfers flock to catch the last waves in the day’s final rays while you enjoy live daily entertainment, sip a frozen Mai Tai, and soak in the view. Ke aloha!

title: ClimbHI

title: Castle Kanaloa at Kona
teaser:
Kanaloa at Kona welcomes the hopeless romantics, the thrill-seekers, and those who just want to have fun. Our resort feels secluded, but is close to charming shops, restaurants, and sits upon the dramatic lava rock coast. You’ll enjoy year-round sailing, snorkeling, and fishing, dine among spectacular Kona sunsets, and fall asleep to the sound of crashing waves.  
  
Our gated condominium resort – nestled on Kona Country Club – has fantastic resort amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 3 hot tubs, and 2 lighted tennis courts. When you’re not out hiking, shopping, or visiting the many cultural sights on the Big Island, sit back and relax on a lounge chair, have a picnic on the coast, or take a stroll around Kanaloa’s expansive resort grounds.

Accommodations: Hotels and Resorts, Condominiums, Vacation Ownership

title: Savvy360
teaser: Savvy360 is a curated travel and lifestyle platform that delivers authentic content for smart travelers. title: Kauai Coffee Company Visitor Center
teaser:
Here at the Kauai Coffee Estate, you’ll have the opportunity to stroll through our coffee orchard, talk to our friendly guides, shop for gifts to take home and of course sample our exclusive line of estate-grown Hawaiian coffees.  
  
The Kauai Coffee Estate is the largest coffee farm in the U.S. We encourage you to see it for yourself and to take one of our free walking tours. You’ll learn all about how our coffee is grown, harvested and roasted right here on the island. After the tour, you can relax on our lanai and take in the beautiful panoramic views of our plantation full of coffee trees that line picturesque fields leading down to the sea.  
  
With a warm Hawaiian aloha from Kauai, we welcome you to visit with us again and again! Mahalo!

title: GuideAlong Audio Tours - Hawaiʻi Island
teaser:
Don't miss a thing as GuideAlong's Audio Driving Tour takes you on an incredible journey across Hawai'i Island. Along the way you'll be guided to all of the island's famous highlights including Volcanoes National Park, the Place of Refuge and Akaka Falls, as well as the best spots for seeing turtles and more lessor known spots across the island.  
  
Hear fascinating behind-the-scenes stories, local tips and directions play automatically along the route, all based on your location.   
  
Choose a full-day Island Circle, a full-day Volcanoes route, or half-day options on the Kohala Coast and the Kona Coffee Coast. GPS-smart narration and offline maps cue directions and stories right where you need them.  
  
Swap lava fields for valleys, petroglyphs for snorkel coves, shave ice for coffee farms, at your speed.  
  
1\. Four routes, mix and match friendly  
2\. Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park highlights made simple  
3\. Local eats, overlooks, and swim spots flagged on the way  
4\. Works offline; start early or sleep in

title: Events International Inc.
teaser: Since 1987 Events International has provided Professional Event Production and Full Service Catering to Hawaii and Across the Pacific. Our Primary Focus is on the Convention, Meeting and Incentive Markets. Offering a Unique Array of Great Venues, Dramatic Prop/Theme/Decor, Entertainment Elements, Professional Staffing and the Very Best in Hawaii's Culinary Talents Have All Built our Exceptional Reputation. We Look Forward to the Opportunity of Surpassing Your Expectations and to Making Your Event Planning as Simple as Possible.

title: Volcano Village Estates
teaser:
Just 1 mile from the entrance to Hawai‘i Volcanoes National Park, Volcano Village Estates offers 13 rooms across private cottages, modern bungalows, and the historic Dillingham House. Wake up in the rainforest, step out to your car, and reach the crater rim before most visitors have finished their coffee.  
  
The 5 original rainforest cottages sit back among native trees with private entrances and quiet surroundings. The bungalows bring a contemporary feel with heated floors, fireplaces, and modern interiors. Several rooms include private hot tubs, full kitchens, and a fire pit.  
  
Every room includes Kona coffee, plush robes, dehumidifiers, mini refrigerators, and heated bed blankets for the cool rainforest nights. An optional in-room breakfast can be added to your stay and stocked in your fridge ahead of arrival, so early hikers can leave at first light and slow mornings can stretch as long as you like.  
  
Visit our website to view rooms and check availability.

Accommodations: Bed and Breakfasts

title: KualoaGrown
teaser:
Kualoa Ranch is a ~4,000 acre private nature reserve located on the windward coast of Oahu. It is also a working cattle ranch, farm, as well as a popular tourist attraction and filming location comprised of three valleys - Hakipuu, Kualoa, and Kaaawa, all of which is home to our KualoaGrown agricultural efforts.  
  
KualoaGrown is the brand of Kualoa Ranch’s diversified agricultural operation. Our team of 45 staff grow, cultivate, and raise food for Hawaii and its visitors. This includes 60 different crops, a variety of tropical flowers, and the production of five types of proteins (beef, pork, shrimp, oysters, and tilapia), making us one of the most diverse farming operations in the state (check out this map to see where our products are grown).  
  
We take immense pride in everything we produce while supporting the local community with high-quality, responsibly-raised food. In addition to cultivating great products, our agricultural efforts also aid in Hawaii’s island food security with 100% of our harvest being consumed locally, helping to support a healthy food system and island community.

title: Kauai Backcountry Adventures
teaser: With exclusive access to over 17,000 acres ofold plantations lands, Kaua`i Backcountry Adventures offers one-of-a-kind experiences. The Backcountry Zipline Adventure traverses a lush mountainside via seven exhilarating ziplines. Soar down into the tropical valley below and enjoy a dip in a mountain swimming hole and delicious picnic. On the Mountain Tubing Adventure you float down the plantation irrigation system on gently flowing water, through canals, flumes and five tunnels hand-dug by plantation workers circa 1870. A swim and picnic await you at the end of this special tour. Don?t be left out when we are sold out. Call us today at 808-245-2506 or toll free at 888-270-0555.

title: Hawaii Ghost Walks
teaser: Haunted history walking tours in Hilo and Kailua-Kona. These Big Island ghost tours are presented by local guides and showcase authentic haunted stories along with folklore from each extraordinary destination. title: Native Hawaiian Hospitality Association
teaser:
The Native Hawaiian Hospitality Association (NaHHA) perpetuates an authentic spirit of aloha and Hawaiian culture in hospitality industry planning, promotion and product development. NaHHA services corporate and community initiatives through project management, consulting, training and facilitation.  
  
NaHHA was founded in 1997 by Dr. George Kanahele, Sen. Kenneth Brown and other Native Hawaiian professionals to address concerns about how Native Hawaiians and Hawaiian culture were perceived and represented in tourism. They determined that, in order to have greater success in improving tourism and honoring Hawaiian culture and its people, they would need support. In 1997, they called a small group of Native Hawaiians together to form NaHHA, a 501(c)3 private nonprofit.   
  
Working to better connect the Hawaiian community and the tourism industry, NaHHA has formed alliances with various Hawaiian organizations and nonprofits, artists and cultural practitioners, and with tourism associations, hotels, and private businesses. These connections and alliances have earned NaHHA the trust of the Hawaiʻi Tourism Authority to work alongside them to achieve their strategic objectives.

teaser:

Owners of the old Waimea Brewing Company, Bret & Janice Larson partnered up with its then Brewer of 13 years, Dave Curry to form a new venture in a greatly improved location 8 miles east in an industrial warehouse better suited to their brewpub theme near the harbor in Port Allen.

With a focus on quality beer and local, sustainable food, Kauai Island Brewing Company serves 14 in-house, micro-brewed beers. Some of the wonderful offerings include Lilikoi Ale, Cane Fire Red, Alakai Stout, Wai’ale’ale Golden Ale and West Side Wheat. The brewpub is a full service restaurant and a full bar with food offerings such as our signature Nui Nacho’s, locally grown grass fed beef burgers, Panko Crusted Calamari Strips, lots of local Bowls or our signature beer battered fish and chips.   
  
Due to the fact that the international dateline runs through American Samoa, Kauai Island Brewing Company can also boast of being the Worlds Westernmost Brewpub, upon which, one would be travelling east after reaching the dateline in American Samoa. We are truly the “Last Beer Before Tomorrow”.

title: Hawaii Geo Tours
teaser: We are two Geologists that founded Hawaii Geo Tours to give guests a more comprehensive understanding of the islands of Hawaii. Our tour begins at a coffee plantation and then onto the famous Punalu'u black sand beach. We offer a list of lunch options, that no other tour company offers, at the Lava Rock Cafe in Volcano Village. We spend the afternoon, longer than any other tour company, in Volcanoes National Park to view not only Kilauea Caldera, but several other historical lava flows down the famous Chain of Craters Road. We finish the tour driving through the historic town of Hilo and over Saddle Road with a once in a lifetime opportunity to view the new lava flows from Mauna Loa in over 38 years!

title: Hilo Beach House Inn
teaser:
Welcome to the Hilo Beach House - A Unique Boutique Inn located in the quiet tropical setting of Onekahakaha Beach Park. Stay at this upscale 4 room Inn. Rest, Relax, and Rejuvenate at this Tropical Oceanfront Retreat.  
  
Each is Asian inspired features with original carved artwork and furniture imported from Bali, split air conditioning units, private screened-in lanai/balcony, with fantastic ocean views and garden views. Enjoy luxury hypoallergenic bedding and a contemporary tropical bathroom design.  
  
A beautiful protected white sand cove great for swimming is located directly in front of our Inn. This Beach Park setting includes spacious grass lawn areas with shade trees, paved ocean side walking paths, lifeguard, barbecue pits, picnic tables, and incredible ocean and island views.   
  
The Inn's Outdoor Dance and Yoga Wellness Atelier features open air salsa and yoga classes to relax your mind, rejuvenate your body, and and restore your soul. Inquiry about our wellness classes (class schedule subject to change according to the teacher's schedules).  
  
Several savory restaurants are located within a 5 minute drive of the inn. The Hilo Farmer's Market, local shops, and downtown Hilo are only a 10 minute drive away. Experience this lush and tropical beach area while being conveniently located near the town of Hilo.  
  
Climb out of bed and dive into the ocean. Rest, Relax, and Rejuvenate at this unique Beachfront Inn.

title: Son'z Steakhouse
teaser:
Son’z Steakhouse focuses on high-quality steaks, chops as well as seafood, while also providing diverse entrees and appetizers that appeal to our guests.  
  
We provide the largest wine selections in the state and our cellar can hold up to 3,000 bottles. We’re featuring the hottest wineries from the United States, France & Italy, as well as one-of-a-kind vintages. We also offer an extensive array of wines by the glass.  
  
The restaurant overlooks the warmly lit lagoon and foliage of the beautiful Swan Court. With a ceiling that’s three stories high, the open-air restaurant ensures guests can relax while dining in style. First class service and superior culinary offerings complete this memorable experience.

title: Kauai Lei Greeting
teaser:
Lihue Airport Lei Greeting. Authentic, Fresh Flower Greeting Upon Arrival On Kauai. Optional Photo.   
  
Enjoy a traditional custom greeting when arriving on Kauai! An authentic symbol of Aloha, love and welcome when you arrive and a great beginning of your holiday on Kauai. An iconic symbol of the island.   
  
Feel the Aloha immediately as KauaiLeiGreeting welcomes you to Kauai and hangs a beautiful, fresh orchid or plumeria flower lei or a ti leaf or kukui nut lei around your neck!   
  
Optional souvenir photo with your own phone is also offered.  
  
Let KauaiLeiGreeting give you your first taste of Aloha!   
  
Arrange your airport Lei greeting upon arrival at Lihue Airport now!

title: The Plumeria Beach House
teaser: On the edge of the white sands of Kahala, the oceanside Plumeria Beach House is our open-air, all day dining restaurant. Reminiscent of a comfortable island home with indoor and outdoor terraces, Plumeria Beach House is an ideal choice for casual dining, quiet meetings and cocktails at sunset.

title: Nick's Fishmarket Maui
teaser:
Nick's Fishmarket Maui offers an innovative, classic cuisine focusing on premier seafood. Specialties include fresh island snapper, mahi mahi, ahi, Hawaiian spiny lobster tail and timeless dishes such as filet mignon, rack of lamb and chicken.  
  
We offer one of the most spectacular list of wine featuring 2,000 bottles in our cellar. Offering fine vintages from Italy, France, Germany and California, both the occasional drinker and the connoisseur will find the perfect compliment to their meal. A full service bar offers the finest in spirits, tropical cocktails as well as wines by the glass.  
  
The romantic flair of the Mediterranean is seen in the restaurant's décor from the rich earth tones of its color scheme to the crisp white curves of its enchanting architecture. The atmosphere continues with unique beautifully designed private booths. Guests dining outdoors will fall under the spell of overhead lights, while looking out over the lush grounds of the resort. For those just stopping by to sample the magic of Nick's Fishmarket Maui, a granite bar provides casual seating for tasty pupu and tempting cocktails. The shimmer of light reflecting from its incredible wine display enhance the entire restaurant.

title: Vacation Realty Hawaii
teaser:
Looking for an unforgettable getaway to Kauai? Come and experience the majestic beauty and Aloha spirit of the Garden Island of Kauai; from the pristine beaches to the breathtaking mountains. Our expert team has personally curated a selection of condo rentals featuring stunning views and accommodations for both small and large groups and all the amenities you'll need to enjoy your stay.   
  
Start your day with a cup of coffee on your private lanai while you enjoy the trade winds. Then, spend your days exploring the island's natural beauty and activities. And when you're ready to unwind, head back to your home away from home to relax in the pool or take a dip in the hot tub.  
  
Our team is dedicated to making your vacation stress-free so you can focus on having fun. In addition, we offer 24/7 customer support, so you can rest easy knowing we've got your back.  
  
Experience your dream vacation with Vacation Realty Hawaii. Book your stay today and get ready to create memories you'll treasure for a lifetime.

teaser:

The hotel offers contemporary guest rooms that are brightly decorated with vibrant colors and chic decors that are consistent with the destination Waikiki.   
  
Book the Stay and surf the Internet for free. Stay Waikiki offers its guests free WiFi internet access in all guest rooms and public areas. Every guest room is equipped with flat-screen televisions, Playstation 2, iPod docking station, and DVD players. Included in the amenity fee are continental breakfast/coffee served daily in the lobby, daily newspaper, and free DVD movies and Play Station video game rentals.

title: Paina Waikiki - the Luau at Waikiki Beach Marriott
teaser:
Pāʻina Waikiki, a unique dinner party luau where the vibrant stories of Waikiki's legendary eras come to life through festive mele (songs), hula and the highest caliber of Polynesian performing arts.  
  
SHOWS: Mon, Wed, Fri, Sun | 5pm-8pm   
  
Guests will be treated to traditional hula as well as new original mele composed just for Pāʻina Waikiki.   
  
In the form of hula kahiko (ancient hula) we bring to life the stories of the elegant homes, lush natural beauty, and brilliant Hawaiian royals that once called these very grounds and Waikiki home.  
  
There will be a gift of hula honoring Hawaii's beloved Queen Liliʻuokalani. A special acknowledgement for Hawaii's last reigning monarch, who spent much of her time right here, where she had two beautiful summer homes. It is here that she would come to retreat, relax, and reflect.

title: CocoNene
teaser: At CocoNene, we create authentically fun products that celebrate home, ʻohana and Hawaiʻi's unique sense of place. We invite customers in to experience the colorful, vibrant fabric of our community, and to capture the moment and what Hawaiʻi means to you. Create your own custom #LongboardLetters to commemorate your Hawaiʻi vacation! From wood wall art to picture frames and holiday decor, everything is proudly made in Hawaiʻi, made with Aloha.

title: Turo

teaser:
Ideally located in the heart of Waikiki, Hilton Waikiki Beach is just one block from the ocean. With Leahi (Diamond Head) as a stunning backdrop, this contemporary Waikiki hotel offers a true Hawaiian paradise.   
  
Full panoramic ocean views from most of our guestrooms! We’re just one block from Waikiki’s beaches, ocean activities, shopping, dining, and entertainment. Walk to the International Market Place, Honolulu Zoo, Waikiki Aquarium and nearby parks. title: Aloha Kai Luau
teaser:
With sweeping ocean views, tucked beneath the stunning Ko‘olau Mountains, Aloha Kai Lū‘au offers the best in authentic, world-class entertainment—just 25 minutes from Waikiki in the heart of Waimānalo!  
  
Experience a bountiful buffet, one-of-a-kind presentations like coconut tree climbing, and cultural activities, where guests can join in kupe‘e (wrist/ankle lei) making, the art of throwing fish nets (‘upena), ukulele lessons, ‘ulu maika (Hawaiian bowling) and more.  
  
Held in the starlit Makapu‘u Meadows on the grounds of Sea Life Park Hawai‘i, Aloha Kai Lū‘au offers three packages to choose from, with Gold and Silver including complimentary admission to our marine park and sanctuary.   
  
Enjoy a coastal drive or be escorted via tour bus to Aloha Kai from several convenient pick-up locations, taking in the renowned beauty of Koko Head, Sandy Beach, and Hanauma Bay along the way.  
  
From fire knife champions to graceful hula, the stage is set for an unforgettable evening in this musical voyage across Polynesia, choreographed by the award-winning Malu Productions.

teaser:
The AC Hotel by Marriott Maui Wailea is precisely placed in the heart of Wailea.   
  
Surround yourself with panoramic views of the coastline from our South Maui hotel where it’s sunny year-round. Wander through the luxurious boutiques, diverse dining options and renowned art galleries at the Shops of Wailea. Stay active while working or playing in the modern fitness center and tennis courts of our Wailea, Hawaii, hotel or while enjoying gorgeous vistas from every hole at nearby championship-level golf courses.   
  
Explore vast stretches of white sand beaches and crystal-blue water or take them in from our infinity pool, made better with expertly crafted cocktails from the pool bar. Bookend your day with a vibrant Wailea sunset on your purposely designed room’s oversized balcony, where you might even catch a once-in-a-lifetime aerial performance from a humpback whale.   
  
The AC Hotel by Marriott Maui Wailea is the perfect precise hotel poised to provide you with a precisely perfect stay in South Maui, Hawaii.

title: Renaissance Honolulu Hotel & Spa
teaser:
Step into a local frame of mind and unexpected discoveries  
  
We're a hotel for the curious, the adventurous, for those who see every journey as a chance to be inspired by the unexpected.   
  
The Renaissance Honolulu Hotel & Spa offers a prime location near the city's vibrant epicenter and its world-famous beaches. Head to our signature Mediterranean restaurant - Mara, featuring a full-service bar with hand-crafted cocktails and a collection of wines from around the world.  
  
Unwind in a cabana by the pool, pamper yourself in our unique Japanese-style spa, push your limits in our fitness center, or simply find solace in the tranquil surroundings

title: Hualani's
teaser:
Experience one of the best restaurants on the island and enjoy farm-to-table oceanfront dining from the elegant yet relaxed setting at Hualani’s on Kaua‘i.  
  
Here, oceanfront dining is influenced by the seasons. What’s fresh at The Farm at Hōkūala inspires the farm-to-table menu, while our bar serves up well-balanced craft cocktails that complement the seasonality of the kitchen.  
  
Our culinary experience is inspired by a sense of place and driven by local farmers, as well as fresh-picked ingredients from our on-site organic farm. From the morning harvest and the daily catch, ​​Hualani’s shines a hyper-local spotlight on the bounty of the Garden Isle.

title: ʻOlu Poolside
teaser: Savor lunch while lounging poolside in Kapalua. Place your dining order directly from your phone using the Marriott Bonvoy mobile app and we'll deliver while you enjoy the view.

title: Mauka Tours
teaser: We are based on Oahu and bring to you decades of experience both in the hospitality industry and in Hawaii tourism. We have long standing relationships and partnerships with many tour operators and pride ourselves on going above and beyond to make your Hawaii experience memorable. By using our services to customize your vacation, you can rest assured that you’ll be making the most of your time and also getting the best price possible. We do not employ high pressure sales tactics like you’ll find with competitors, just honest and wholesome advice.

title: Lā Kāhea Community Farm
teaser:
Lā Kāhea Community Farm, nestled in the heart of Maui, invites you to discover one-of-a-kind experiences that are truly unparalleled. Our team warmly welcomes you to partake in our exclusive Taste of Hawaii Farm Tour and Farm-To-Table Cooking Class, using the freshest farm-grown ingredients.  
  
Here, you can do more than just observe - you can immerse yourself in the world of nature and sustainability, gaining knowledge that's as enriching as the flavors you'll savor. If you're a curious traveler, nature lover, or a passionate food enthusiast, Lā Kāhea offers something truly exceptional for you.  
  
But the uniqueness doesn't stop there. If a tour isn't in the cards, don't miss 'Āina Tacos, our Farm-To-Taco concept, available each Saturday at the Upcountry Farmers Market and Maui SWAP Meet. Our menu is a delectable testament to locally sourced, organically grown ingredients from our very own farm!

title: Arden Waikīkī
teaser:
Nestled in a sanctuary at the foot of Diamond Head in Waikiki, Arden invites you to discover the essence of Contemporary Hawaii Cuisine where flavors, cultures, and a dedication to genuine culinary craft intertwine to create an exceptional dining experience.  
  
Culinary artisans Makoto Ono and Amanda Cheng welcome you into their world of edible expression where every moment is woven into a cherished memory.

title: Solera
teaser:
At Solera, we are inspired by Hawaii’s unique sense of place and rich, deeply-rooted flavors while honoring its harmonious blending of global influences. We celebrate the timeless balance of tradition and innovation, creating dishes that honor the past while embracing a forward-thinking approach.  
  
With a focus on local ingredients and global influences, Solera offers an elevated dining experience that is sophisticated, soulful, and refreshingly modern. Our story is one of evolution, artistry, and connection–a solera system.  
  
Breakfast at Solera features Local and International Favorites including Loco Moco, Korean Chicken & Waffle, and our Breakfast Bento. We hope to create a space that offers comfort and elegance, a piece of home for visiting guests, or a destination for our Kama'aina.

title: Quiora
teaser:
Quiora - where the flavors of Italy, the Mediterranean, and the spirit of Hawaii come together. With a passion for supporting our local community, we take pride in sourcing our ingredients from local farmers, fisheries, and ranchers, ensuring a touch of Hawaii in every dish.  
  
Our lunch menu brings hints of Italian flavors from our dinner menu while featuring a delightful array of lunchtime favorites.   
  
Enjoy panoramic views of Waikiki's skyline and the Pacific Ocean through Quiora's open-air dining room located on the 8th Floor of the Ritz Carlton Residences, Waikiki Beach.

title: AC Hotel by Marriott Honolulu
teaser:
Located in the heart of Honolulu, the AC Hotel by Marriott Honolulu is an urban retreat designed with today’s travelers in mind.   
  
With everything you need and nothing you don’t, our 112-room boutique hotel is on Bishop Street in the hub of Honolulu’s business district, close to Hawaii’s Chinatown featuring vibrant nightlife, beautiful art, and the best spot in town to grab fresh lei.   
  
From our lobby design with an open floor plan to our speakeasy bar, we immerse you in a unique Hawaiian getaway. Our downtown Honolulu guest rooms are designed to maximize space, openness, and provide ultimate guest comfort. Experience a healthy, European-inspired breakfast in the AC Kitchen or enjoy cocktails, craft beers, wines, and a food menu inspired by the tapas of Spain in our AC Lounge.   
  
For something truly unique, try our speakeasy which features eclectic décor and incredible cocktails to delight travelers and locals alike. Host an impromptu meeting in our 2,500 sq. ft. of event space with natural light.

Accommodations: Hotels and Resorts, Condominiums, Vacation Ownership

title: Lonohana Estate Chocolate
teaser:
Lonohana Estate Chocolate grows cacao on the North Shore of Oahu and makes fine finished chocolate in Honolulu using 100% Hawaii-grown cacao.   
  
As one of Hawaii's few vertically integrated chocolate companies, visitors can see and learn how world class chocolate can be grown from tree to bar, right here in Hawaii.   
  
Complementary chocolate tasting flights are available 7-days a week at the Tasting Bar located in SALT @OurKaka'ako and highly educational, immersive tours and tastings are held at our chocolate factory three blocks away.

title: Kids City Hawaii
teaser:
Kids City, a locally-owned company with two convenient locations in Honolulu and Kapolei. Our mission is to provide families, especially kids, with a unique and enriching indoor playground experience that is both safe and educational.   
  
At Kids City, we cater to children aged 10 months to 13 years, offering a wide range of activities designed to stimulate their minds and keep them physically active. What sets us apart is our commitment to safety and quality. Our play structures are carefully crafted with children and parents in mind, ensuring a secure and enjoyable environment.   
  
Our diverse offerings include ninja warriors, ziplines, obstacles, slides, a water table, pretend play areas, a ball pool, interactive games, arts and crafts, and much more!

title: Maui Snorkeling
teaser: Maui Snorkeling hosts all-inclusive public and private snorkel and whale watch tours to the Molokini Crater, Coral Gardens, and Turtle Town. Our morning tour visits the Molokini crater and one other location in the morning. Our afternoon tour visits one snorkeling location in the afternoon. We have a 25 foot fast inflatable waterslide that guests of all ages enjoy.

title: Hawaiian B Natural Farms
teaser: Experience the intense flavors of fresh hibiscus along with our flowers in syrup, preserves and tea, while you’re guided through our estate greenhouse and outdoor exploration garden. Everyone is familiar with the showy hibiscus flower, but we mainly grow the edible kind called Hibiscus Roselle. Roselle is a tropical plant historically used for medicinal purposes and still has many health benefits today. Actively enjoy both our indoor hydroponic farm and outdoor garden we use for multiple edible varieties. Savor the taste of each of our specialty products grown, harvested and produced right here on the farm. Immerse yourself in a behind the scenes tour of our farm with a 45-minute light walking tour with firsthand explanations from the owner, followed by hibiscus tea and other unique snacks. Take pictures and enjoy all the views of both the farm and ocean, all the while engaging in Q&A.; We invite you to enjoy this uniquely tropical plant.

title: ʻIkena
teaser: Translated from Hawaiian, ʻIkena can mean a view, seeing, knowing, association, scenery, or knowledge. It’s the perfect name, then, for our signature indoor-outdoor breakfast buffet, which offers picturesque views of the sea and sky from every table. Feel connected to the rhythm of the waves lapping Wailea Beach, the swaying of the palms, and the soothing sounds of birdsong amid ʻIkena’s soaring interior, brought to life via Maui’s natural beauty.

title: Olivine
teaser: Welcome to Olivine, a new oceanfront culinary destination where the natural bounty of Maui is perfectly paired with the art of coastal Italian cuisine. Named after one of Maui’s primary minerals, Olivine is a celebration of earth’s renewal, featuring handmade pastas and seasonal dishes that infuse local Hawaiian ingredients with authentic Italian flavors.

title: Oahu Genius
teaser:
Oahu Genius is Honolulu’s premier Destination Management Company (DMC), trusted by meeting planners worldwide to deliver seamless, high-impact events in the heart of Hawai‘i. With unmatched local expertise, an extensive network of top-tier vendors, and a deep understanding of Hawai‘i’s cultural and logistical landscape, Oahu Genius transforms complex event planning into a stress-free, unforgettable experience.  
  
Whether it’s a corporate conference, incentive program, or large-scale gathering, Oahu Genius specializes in custom-curated experiences, tailored logistics, and flawless execution. From venue sourcing and transportation to entertainment, décor, and unique island excursions, we handle every detail with precision and creativity—allowing planners to focus on their attendees while we bring the magic of O‘ahu to life.  
  
With a reputation built on reliability, innovation, and authentic Hawaiian hospitality, Oahu Genius is the go-to DMC partner for large events in Honolulu. When excellence is non-negotiable, meeting planners choose Oahu Genius.  
  
-Single Property & Citywide Programs  
-Planning & Strategy  
-FAM Tours & Site Inspections

title: Hawaiian Council
teaser: The Council for Native Hawaiian Advancement (CNHA) is a member-based 501(c)3 non-profit organization with a mission to enhance the cultural, economic, political, and community development of Native Hawaiians. Headquartered in Kapolei, CNHA is a Native Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) certified by the U.S. Treasury department and a HUD-Certified Housing Counseling agency. We provide access to capital, financial education and individualized financial counseling services with a focus on low and moderate-income families. CNHA serves as a National Intermediary, providing grants and loans targeting underserved communities in Hawaiʻi.

title: Kona Cloud Forest Sanctuary
teaser:
Reservations are required.  
We curate special experiences for groups - please call.  
  
🌿 Welcome to Kona Cloud Forest Sanctuary, where cool air and lush greenery awaits 15 minutes from the Kona Airport, on the Island of Hawai’i! We invite you to step into a world of wonder in Hawaii's only seasonally dry Cloud Forest.   
  
In this living classroom, we invite you to learn about the important role of the Cloud Forest through immersive experiences including educational ecotours, forest bathing, sound bath and guided meditations, yoga, themed workshops and more, all designed to deepen your connection to Hawai’i, nature, and your inner well-being.

At Diamond Head State Monument, visitors can enjoy the official self-guided audio hiking tour and commemorate their adventure with exclusive merchandise—including our popular Sanrio Collection—available only at the Diamond Head Visitor Center.

title: PAʻI Foundation
teaser:
PAʻI is the acronym for Pua Ali‘i ‘Ilima, the hālau hula (school of Hawaiian dance) founded in 1977 by kumu hula (master teacher of Hawaiian dance), Vicky Holt Takamine. Established in 2001 as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, PA‘I’s mission is to preserve and perpetuate Native Hawaiian cultural traditions for future generations. We are guided and led by our founder and executive director Vicky Holt Takamine who is recognized as a Native Hawaiian advocate and community organizer around the issues of Native rights and the protection of the natural and cultural resources of Hawai‘i that are so vital to the perpetuation of Native Hawaiian cultural traditions.  
  
PA‘I is anchored by members of Takamine’s hālau hula (traditional dance school), Pua Ali‘i ‘Ilima. While the perception of hula for many is that it is a form of entertainment for tourists or a hobby for individuals all around the world, hula has been instrumental in the preservation and perpetuation of Native Hawaiian language, art and cultural practices. Springing from her vision, PA‘I sees Native Hawaiian artistic practices as a form of resistance, and often uses art for organizing and empowerment. PA‘I is the Hawaiian word for “sudden impact or slap”.  
  
Mission: To preserve and perpetuate Native Hawaiian arts and cultural traditions for future generations.  
  
Vision: To establish and maintain a sustainable Native Hawaiian arts and culture center in urban Honolulu.

title: Hawaiʻi Food & Wine Festival
teaser:
The Hawaii Food & Wine Festival is the premier culinary destination event in the Pacific.  
  
A three-weekend epicurean experience that spans three islands each fall, the Hawaii Food & Wine Festival (HFWF) is the largest food festival in Hawaii. Co-founded by two of Hawaii’s own James Beard Award-winning chefs—Roy Yamaguchi and Alan Wong—the Festival showcases Hawaii’s rich agricultural diversity and homegrown culinary talent through world-class culinary experiences.  
  
Each year, more than 150 internationally renowned master chefs, culinary personalities, sommeliers, mixologists, and wine and spirit producers are invited to participate in roughly 20 events, from grand tastings and wine dinners to kids cooking classes, wine seminars and more. Unlike other food festivals across the country, HFWF challenges participating chefs to use at least one locally grown, raised or caught ingredient in their dish, connecting Hawaii’s farmers, ranchers and fishermen to thousands of attendees each year. As a program of the nonprofit, Hawaii Ag and Culinary Alliance, HFWF has donated nearly $5 million to community and aina-based organizations that support sustainability, culinary and agricultural education, and cultural programs in Hawaii since 2011.

title: Assets School
teaser: Founded in 1955, Assets is the ONLY school in Hawai‘i specializing in educating students who are gifted, dyslexic, or have other language-based learning differences in grades kindergarten through twelfth. We are a school where personalized learning is a reality, where a strength-based curriculum brings out a child's natural curiosity and interest in learning. At Assets, students with great minds who think differently find joy, and belonging and develop their talents to benefit society in previous unimagined ways. Our students are accepted and affirmed as learners and individuals, where the whole student matters--academic, social and emotional development are valued equally. Our school offers an award-winning robotics program, drama, art, music, technology design, and more. Our high school students thrive in our Mentorship Program which along with their studies prepares them for college and their career path. All students beginning in the ninth-grade work with our College and Career Counselor. All of our 2024 graduates were accepted to college. Financial Aid is available, and we provide private tours. We have year-round enrollment and offer outstanding summer school opportunities for grades kindergarten through twelfth, and summer camps. In 2022, Assets opened the Transforming Lives Center which is the first private school-based full resource center on O‘ahu to provide comprehensive assessments of students who maybe struggling in a traditional school setting or facing academic challenges. At a reasonable fee, any student kindergarten through twelfth-grade can be assessed. Learn more at assets-school.org/community/transforming-lives-center. Assets also offers a complimentary reading screening to public, private, charter, or homeschooled students from mid-kindergarten through third grade. Children who encounter challenges in reading, rhyming, and mastering the alphabet are the best candidates. The Predictive Assessment of Reading (PAR) assesses your child's reading proficiency and identifies areas where they might need more help. The screening will take place at the K-8 campus at One ‘Ohana Nui Way and is by appointment only. Learn more at assets-school.org/community/reading-screening-info. title: Papahānaumokuākea Marine Debris Project
teaser:
The Papahānaumokuākea Marine Debris Project (PMDP) is a Hawaiʻi based 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to protecting one of the most remote and ecologically significant marine ecosystems on Earth. The organization focuses on cleaning up marine debris within the Papahānaumokuākea National Marine Sanctuary (the Northwestern Hawaiian Islands). This UNESCO World Heritage Site supports diverse coral reef systems and is home to endangered Hawaiian monk seals, threatened sea turtles, seabirds, and many other native species that are vulnerable to entanglement and ingestion of ocean debris.  
  
Since its founding in 2019, the organization has led large scale ship-based marine debris removal expeditions to this remote region of Hawaiʻi, with a particular emphasis on the removal of lost and abandoned fishing gear (ghost nets). Teams of experienced divers and field specialists conduct hands-on cleanup operations, removing debris that poses immediate threats to living corals, marine life and shoreline habitats. Since 2020, PMDP has removed 1.2 million pounds of marine debris from these sensitive habitats, providing the best chance of survival for sensitive wildlife.  
  
In addition to field operations, the organization works to raise public awareness about the global marine debris problem and its impacts on Hawaiʻi and the Pacific. It engages communities through education and outreach, supports stewardship grounded in cultural values, and collaborates with researchers to improve understanding of debris sources and impacts. The Papahānaumokuākea Marine Debris Project partners closely with federal and state agencies and philanthropic supporters to sustain and expand its efforts to protect this irreplaceable marine environment for future generations.

“Te Au Moana,” meaning “The Ocean Tide,” draws inspiration from Hawaiʻi’s profound ancestral relationship with the sea — as a source of sustenance, exploration, and cultural identity. The production weaves together mele (song), hula (dance), and oli (chant) alongside broader Polynesian performance traditions, guiding guests on a journey across Hawaiʻi and the Pacific. Through dynamic choreography, live music, and a commanding fire knife performance, the show honors Hawaiʻi’s voyaging heritage and the interconnected cultures of Oceania.  
  
The culinary program complements the evening’s performances with a curated island feast featuring traditional Hawaiian fare alongside contemporary local cuisine. Each show evening includes the ceremonial unveiling of puaʻa kalua from the imu, grounding the experience in the time-honored culinary practice while maintaining the refinement expected within a Wailea luxury resort setting.  
  
Recognized as Maui’s finest lūʻau experiences, Te Au Moana consistently delivers production excellence, a strong reputation, and an enduring commitment to cultural stewardship through music, dance, and hospitality.
