Andaz Maui at Wailea radiates luxury at every turn, inviting you to revel in a unique Hawaiian cultural experience. This is the first Andaz resort in the world, designed by world-renowned architects, the Rockwell Group, capturing the spirit and feel of today's Hawaiʻi. Andaz Maui at Wailea Resort & Spa stays true to one of its essential brand elements, being part of its neighborhood. Services are centered around being uncomplicated and pleasantly unpredictable for the savvy traveler. Known for its superior quality and service delivery, this Andaz is no different. Perched along crescent-shaped shores, the newly-unveiled 15-acre beachfront resort immerses you in the warm, welcoming spirit of Hawaiʻi, with guestrooms that offer refreshing rain showers and a host of complimentary luxuries.

Accommodations: Hotels and Resorts, Condominiums, Vacation Ownership

title: Pearl at Kalauao
teaser:
Pearl at Kalauao is dedicated to providing an enriched golfing experience for golfers of all backgrounds, embracing both kama‘āina (person of the land) and malihini (visitors) to Hawai‘i nei.  
  
Pearl at Kalauao redefines the golf experience as a preferred gathering place featuring a refreshed, challenging course, amenities and facilities that celebrate the area’s rich history. ‘Ohana are invited to enjoy Pearl’s upgraded banquet, meeting and special event facilities, as well as delicious dining options that complement the picturesque 18-hole golf course. The varied terrain, challenging layout and stunning panoramic views tee up a memorable round for golfers of all levels of play, and this hidden gem continues to dazzle first-time and loyal players.

title: Botero Lounge
teaser: Maui’s nightlife and bar is best enjoyed amidst Hawaii’s largest collection of art including the famous sculptures of Fernando Botero.

title: Hawaii Ocean Rafting
teaser: Native Hawaiian owned & awarded TripAdvisors Traveler's Choice, we've been offering whale watches and snorkel eco-tours for more than 30 years! No crowds on our small group whale watch or beginner friendly Lanai snorkel tours departing from Lahaina, Maui. Our small group tours make for a fun, family style experience! Encounter dolphins and whales at eye-level on our low-to-water adventure raft. Maui Whale Watching tours are seasonal from December-April when humpback whales migrate to Maui! Join us for a Hawaii Ocean Rafting adventure shared or private charter, you won’t forget!

title: The Cliffs at Princeville
teaser:
Come away to the Cliffs at Princeville, where tropical mountains meet crystal blue waters.  
  
Located on the beautiful north shore of the Garden Island of Kauai, The Cliffs at Princeville lies within the Princeville Resort area on 22 acres of lush tropical garden land. Often referred to as simply “The Cliffs”, the property is situated on a high bluff, overlooking the north Pacific.   
  
Offering ocean and island views, our units are spacious and are equipped with a fully-equipped kitchen, two full baths, and two private lanais. We offer one bedroom and one bedroom with loft suites. Ideal for couples and families, the one bedroom suites can sleep up to four persons and the one bedroom with loft suites can sleep up to six persons.

Accommodations: Hotels and Resorts, Condominiums, Vacation Ownership

title: Hawaiian Paddle Sports
teaser: Hawaiian Paddle Sports provides authentic sustainable eco-tours that encourage guests to discover a deeper appreciation of and connection to Hawaii’s marine environment. The company’s ocean guides and instructors are knowledgeable, friendly, and the best in the business, and all guides are CPR, lifeguard and marine naturalist certified. Focused on environmental stewardship, community service and sense of place, Hawaiian Paddle Sports is a proud Certified B Corporation and a certified sustainable tour operator by the Hawaii Ecotourism Association. Founded in 2010, Hawaiian Paddle Sports has organized a monthly give back program for local nonprofits and environmental organizations since its inception. For more information on Hawaiian Paddle Sports, visit HawaiianPaddleSports.com.

title: Ruth's Chris Steak House - Wailea
teaser: Nationally renowned for classic steak house cuisine, featuring US Prime steaks, premium seafood & delectable vegetable menu items. The Ruth's Chris experience includes superior service & excellent wine selections. Voted "Best Steak House" on the Islands.

title: Ruth's Chris Steak House - Honolulu
teaser: Nationally renowned for classic steak house cuisine, featuring US Prime steaks, premium seafood & delectable vegetable menu items. The Ruth's Chris experience includes superior service & excellent wine selections. Voted "Best Steak House" on the Islands.

title: Shoreline Hotel Waikiki
teaser:
Just about everything on Waikiki Beach has been discovered, except maybe Shoreline Waikiki Hotel. In the heart of Waikiki, and only seconds from Waikiki Beach, this peaceful hotel is your hidden sanctuary in Honolulu’s premier shopping and dining district.  
  
DESIGN INTENT: Influenced by the local spirit and nature of Honolulu, this new hotel offers an experience that is inviting, intriguing, fresh, and relaxing, where simplicity and practicality are key. Surrounded by natural grandeur, the hotel offers a match of luxury and balance with tasteful sophistication, complimented by modernistic intention.

Accommodations: Hotels and Resorts, Condominiums, Vacation Ownership

title: Kona Ocean Adventures
teaser:
Kona Ocean Adventures  
  
With Kona Ocean Adventures we are not just another tour but a true adventure every time you step aboard our boats.  
  
Snorkeling, Scuba Diving, whale watching, sunset cruise, manta ray night snorkel and dive? You have come to the right place! Private charters are our specialty. With 3 boats we keep our mixed groups small (typically 6-8 guests) yet our boats are certified up to 17 passengers.  
  
Take time to include le’ale’a in life!  
With over 30 years of experience navigating the Hawaiian waters, Laure, Danny and their crew are a true treasure chest of local knowledge and insider information about where to go, what to do, and how to do it, but their attitude is what really makes them special. You’ll feel like you’re on the boat with good friends… who happen to be local expert guides and coast guard licensed captains… We are passionate about what we do and love the ocean.  
  
We have chosen to remain a small boutique company in town to keep doing what we do best…. Continue to provide the best service possible with Aloha everyday! While on board, be sure to sample Captain’s Danny home made salsa. That is his specialty after all.

title: Coconut Waikiki Hotel
teaser: The 81-room Coconut Waikiki Hotel offers guests a colorful, contemporary twist on classic Waikiki style with an art deco-inspired design. Located just three blocks from the world famous Waikiki Beach, the hotel provides easy access to Waikiki's array of shops, restaurants and nightlife as well as the beach. Guest rooms feature free Wi-Fi, private lanai and views of the Koolau Mountains or Waikiki. The hotel has an intimate pool area with a wrap-around deck and a fitness center.

Accommodations: Hotels and Resorts, Condominiums, Vacation Ownership

title: Royal Coconut Coast Association
teaser: The Royal Coconut Coast Association is a great link to information about Kauai’s convenient Wailua to Kapaa region. This area is known for its abundant royal coconut palm trees, affordable lodging, enjoyable beach parks, Hawaii’s only navigable river, an extraordinary coastal bike path, numerous quaint shops and restaurants along with scenic hiking and world-class golf. Find out about where to stay, where to dine, what to do, what's going on, what's unique about this area and how to get around. Visit us at www.royalcoconutcoast.com.

Accommodations: Directories and Guides

title: Boss Frog's
teaser:
We specialize in snorkel gear rentals, bicycle, surfboard, stand up paddle board, body board and flotation device rentals. We also have other beach rental items such as chairs, umbrellas and coolers.   
  
We currently have 9 shops on Maui, 3 on Kauai, and 1 on the Big Island of Hawaii. We offer discount activity tickets on almost all of the most popular Maui, Kauai & Hawaii snorkeling tours and all other activities. Luaus, Molokini snorkeling tours, ziplines, horseback riding and helicopter tours; You name it, and most likely we have several options for you and your family. Our friendly, knowledgeable, professional staff is dedicated to providing information and an experience that will exceed your expectations.

title: Amstar Hawaii, DBA Worldstar DMC
teaser:
We are a full service Destination Management Company that caters to all the Hawaiian Islands, Kauai, Oahu, Maui, Lanai and the Big Island of Hawaii, specializing in corporate, associations, and executive travels. With our local partnerships, we customize your program to be fresh and to suit your objective and goal. Our philosophy is to reflect enthusiasm, creativity, expertise, and Hawaiian culture with the Spirit of Aloha through our dedicated staff and continuously achieve success by going that extra mile for you and your guests.  
  
Amstar celebrates 25 years in operations in 2014.

title: Premier Kauai Vacation Rentals
teaser: Nestled along Kauai's Royal Coconut Coast is our unique collection of properties that offer more than just a place to stay—they are the beginning of your Kauai story. At Premier Kauai Vacation Rentals, we're not just hosts, we're your local guides to paradise. Our team is committed to offering a warm, home-like experience with resort-level amenities. As a proud woman and Hawaiian-owned business, we are dedicated to serving our guests, owners, sellers, and the community.

Accommodations: Vacation Rentals
Wi-Fi Access: All Units equipped with Internet and Wi-Fi

title: Volcano Village Lodge
teaser:
Just 2 miles from the main entrance to Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park, Volcano Village Lodge offers a small collection of private cedar cottages set within a native rainforest. Step out onto your covered lanai, listen for the birdsong in the canopy, and reach the crater rim before the day's first crowds arrive.  
  
Each cottage feels tucked among the trees, with floor-to-ceiling windows that bring the rainforest right into the room. Inside, you'll find a private bath, an electric fireplace for cool evenings, plush linens, bed warmers, and views of giant ferns just outside. The intimate scale of the property means it never feels busy, and service stays personal throughout your stay.  
  
A home-made in-room breakfast is delivered to your room each day to be enjoyed at your leisure each morning, paired with fresh market fruits, so you can take your time over coffee or head out at first light. Walking paths wind through the property, and a shared hot tub gives guests a place to unwind under the rainforest canopy after a day in the park.  
  
Visit our website to view rooms and check availability.

Accommodations: Bed and Breakfasts

title: Ocean Organic Farm and Distillery
teaser:
Situated on 80-acres of breathtaking views from the slopes of Haleakala, is Ocean Organic Farm and Distillery, the home of Ocean Organic Vodka. Centrally located and an easy drive from Maui’s International Kahului Airport, as well as the island’s world-famous resorts.   
  
Come visit us and learn about our company’s commitment to producing some of the world's finest spirits. Visit our Farm Store where you'll find our full collection of premium spirits and apparel. Then, stop by our Café and take in the stunning bicoastal views while enjoying locally inspired fare along with one of our signature cocktails.   
  
The Café also features live music daily starting at 4:30pm. Guided personal tastings are also available. Tastings include the history of Ocean Organic Farm and Distillery, and the unique processes that go into producing our award-winning spirits. Tastings are offered every half hour from 11am to 5pm and include a lineup of 5 of our spirits for $18.

Activities: Distilleries, Breweries, Wineries, Cideries, and Meaderies

title: The Ritz-Carlton Maui, Kapalua
teaser: Nestled on 54 acres, The Ritz-Carlton, Kapalua showcases a stunning, AAA Five-Diamond oceanfront destination resort offering 463 guestrooms, including 107 newly renovated one- and two-bedroom residential suites with kitchens, separate living rooms and stunning views. The Spa beckons with treatment rooms framed by private garden showers, volcanic stone grottos, heat therapies, and a fitness center with spectacular ocean views. Jean-Michel Cousteau's Ambassadors of the Environment offers all levels activities from land to sea. Also featured are six restaurants, indoor/outdoor meeting space, an inviting children's pool and luxury cabanas. The hotel is enveloped by picturesque Kapalua Resort’s two championship golf courses, dining and a century-old pineapple plantation.

Accommodations: Hotels and Resorts, Condominiums, Vacation Ownership

title: Wheelers Van Rentals of Hawaii
teaser:
Wheelers Accessible Van Rentals of Hawaii has been providing affordable wheelchair accessible van rentals throughout the state of Hawaii since 2005. We are the only company that is able to offer van rentals on Maui, Kaui, Oahu, and the island of Hawaii.  
  
All of our vans are specially modified by Vantage Mobility Inc, or Braun Mobility. Airport and cruise ship terminal deliveries are available upon request. Our fleet includes wheelchair/scooter accessible Dodge, Chrysler, and Toyota minivans.  
  
In conjunction with our van rentals we also offer power chairs, scooters and other medical equipment for rent on Oahu only. We accept all major credit cards including JCB and Discover. Please check our Yelp listing for reviews and specials!

title: Hui Noʻeau Visual Arts Center
teaser: Historic site, group tours. Art classes, exhibits, workshops, studios, lectures, gift shop, mansion, botanical gardens.

title: The Orchid Lei Company
teaser: We specialize in providing quality leis and flowers for businesses and wholesale clients.

title: Surfing Goat Dairy
teaser: State of the art working goat dairy with over 25 cheeses including 11 National Award winners. Daily casual tours, grand's orchard tours, barbeques, special events, goat milk soaps, citrus relishes, specialty fruits & herbs.

title: Kapalua Ziplines
teaser: Maui's only ALL-dual zipline is located on the lush volcanic slopes of the West Maui Mountains. A trek on a suspension bridge, ATV ride, spectacular ocean views and 2 miles of ziplines are all included in your adventure!

title: The Grove Restaurant
teaser:
It’s easy to feel drawn to THE GROVE Restaurant & Bar at THE MODERN HONOLULU. Arbors, bougainvillea and hibiscus create a garden allure among the alfresco seating of THE GROVE; lush banquettes and overstuffed wicker chairs beckon you to lounge in the passageway area, an alcove fringed with ferns and palm fronds. Rays of sun and ocean breezes touch the spaces, each with a view to THE MODERN HONOLULU’s Sunrise Pool and yacht harbor just beyond.  
  
To slow things down – anytime – alone or with friends old and new. It’s also one of the best places to eat among Waikiki restaurants. To start, command a table and a freshly brewed Starbucks coffee. Mid-day into the evening, stop in for fresh salads, sandwiches, and light and sustaining plates showcasing island-grown goodness.  
  
As aperitifs, accompaniments or all on their own, drinks at THE GROVE Restaurant & Bar are as stylish as the surrounds. Choose from our expertly-curated wine list, island microbrews and signature cocktails. It’s perfectly acceptable to pop in casually at THE GROVE. Then the open air envelops you. You find the buzz of guests flowing to and from the pool entrancing; the vignettes as inviting for solitary relaxation as they are for gathering a group. You decide to stay awhile – even if just to enjoy Happy Hour and reflect on this uncommon experience in Honolulu dining.

title: Kauai Bound
teaser: Kauai Bound is a locally owned snorkel, golf, underwater camera, and beach rental and retail shop located in Lihue at Anchor Cove Shopping Center. We carry quality dry snorkels with silicone masks, new Wilson golf sets, underwater cameras, and more! Available daily or weekly rentals for very reasonable prices.

title: Kane Plantation Guesthouse
teaser: A luxury boutique Guesthouse in Captain Cook, South Kona on Hawaii Island, at the historic former home of artist and historian Herb Kawainui Kane. Situated on a 16-acre avocado farm with views from Kealakekua Bay to Honaunau, this all-suite B&B; is the perfect location to relax and explore Hawaii Island.

Accommodations: Bed and Breakfasts

title: Vive Hotel Waikiki
teaser: Boutique & Lifestyle hotel featuring 124 guest rooms and suites. Vive Hotel Waikiki has just completed a multimillion dollar complete renovation.

Accommodations: Hotels and Resorts, Condominiums, Vacation Ownership

title: The Resort at Kapalua Bay, Maui
teaser:
Set along the tranquil shores of Kapalua Bay, this distinguished Maui retreat offers a rare balance of natural beauty and refined sophistication. Framed by the Pacific Ocean and lush tropical landscapes, the resort presents an intimate sense of place where privacy, space, and understated elegance define the experience.  
  
Spacious, residential‑style accommodations feature gracious living areas, private lanais, and thoughtful design that blends island influences with timeless luxury. Culinary experiences are artfully curated, from ocean‑view dining to exclusive private venues designed for memorable gatherings and celebrations.  
  
Guests are invited to unwind through personalized wellness experiences, championship golf, and immersive ocean activities, all delivered with anticipatory service and quiet precision. Whether hosting an intimate occasion or seeking a serene escape, this Maui sanctuary offers an elevated setting where every moment feels considered, unhurried, and distinctly refined.

Accommodations: Hotels and Resorts, Condominiums, Vacation Ownership
Tennis Courts: Yes, located within the Kapalua Resort

title: Maui Kayak Adventures LLC
teaser:
Immerse yourself in the aquatic enchantment of the island with Maui Kayak Adventures, an organization that thrives on delivering once-in-a-lifetime experiences. We offer a unique blend of exploration, excitement, and education, inviting you to embark on stunning kayak adventures that uncover the island's marine beauty. Our tours go beyond mere sightseeing, taking you on a thrilling journey of wildlife encounters and snorkeling, all set against the breathtaking backdrop of Maui's waterscapes.  
  
Our team of Certified Marine Naturalists guides each adventure, ensuring your safety while offering intriguing insights into Maui's vibrant marine ecosystem. As an Eco-Tourism Certified company, we are deeply committed to preserving our ocean's health. Each adventure with us is infused with a sense of stewardship, creating not just action-packed excursions, but also enriching experiences that deepen your connection with the ocean. Join Maui Kayak Adventures and make incredible oceanic memories while contributing positively to our planet's future.

title: Ka‘u Coffee Mill
teaser: Kau Coffee Mill is a grower and producer of coffee with 100 acres in production. Provides a full range of services from pulping to roasting for local farmers. A visitors center and retail store is located at the Mill and is open 7 days a week to sell our roasted coffees and macadamia nuts. Tours are provided for anyone interested in learning more about the coffee industry.

title: 'AMA'AMA
teaser:
Enjoy a newly reimagined fine-dining experience at ‘AMA‘AMA, where you’ll savor a delectable four-course prix-fixe dinner inspired by the vibrant spirit of Hawai‘i. Each dish is crafted with exceptional ingredients and showcases locally harvested fish and produce, with most of the menu naturally gluten-free. Guests will also find plant-based choices available for every course, ensuring a wide range of dietary preferences can discover Hawai‘i’s renowned tastes.  
  
This fresh menu highlights modern interpretations of island cuisine, featuring standout selections such as “lox” opakapaka served with fresh greens, citrus, and an assortment of raw and pickled vegetables, as well as a succulent Pork Belly paired with “scanlan sauce,” sweet onion, local kiawe honey, and Okinawan sweet potato.  
  
For the finale, our Pastry Chef presents an enticing array of desserts, each one infused with beloved island flavors—including liliko‘i, calamansi, coconut, mango, macadamia, and Kona coffee. To complement your dining experience, ‘AMA‘AMA offers a thoughtfully curated global wine list, perfect for toasting any special occasion.

title: Makahiki - The Bounty of the Islands
teaser:
Discover Makahiki — The Bounty of the Islands, where you can enjoy dinner and a character breakfast featuring fresh ingredients and international flavors, served in a vibrant, open-air dining room.  
  
Start your morning with a plentiful breakfast, complete with appearances by beloved Disney Characters—keep an eye out for Mickey Mouse and his pals, who greet guests daily during breakfast at Makahiki. Throughout your meal, you’ll have opportunities to snap photos and share magical moments with your favorite Disney Characters.  
  
In the evening, indulge in a delicious three-course dinner crafted with seasonal ingredients and chef-inspired creations. Choose from a variety of starters, entrées, and desserts, including mouthwatering seafood, tender steaks, flavorful plant-based options, and more.

title: Kona Salt Farm by Sea Salts of Hawaii
teaser: Visit Kona Salt Farm — oceanfront and just 10 mins from the airport! Tour Hawai‘i Island’s only working salt farm, learn how we harvest salt from deep ocean water 2,200 feet below the surface, and enjoy a tasting of Kona Pure and Flavored Salts. Refresh after your flight with a 48°F deep ocean water foot soak. Farm Store with local salt gifts and wellness products. Or just stop in for a complimentary salt tasting.

title: Lava Lava Beach Club
teaser: On 10 beachfront acres at Anaeho'omalu Bay, guests of Lava Lava Beach Club dine, drink, celebrate, and revel in the laidback luxury of four contemporary Hawaiian cottages and an open air restaurant with entertainment nightly which is open to the public for lunch and dinner. Nibble and nosh on fun, island-style pupus, entrées, and desserts as well as delicious wines and LLBC mixologist’s island-style creations at the full-service beach bar. A weekend Bloody Mary Beach Brunch takes traditional bloody marys to a whole other level each Saturday and Sunday from 9am until 2pm with the regular lunch menu kicking in at noon as well. The stunning beachfront venue is also home to a landscaped event lawn ideal for family reunions, company banquets or romantic weddings with the bay as backdrop providing all the decor needed. Get some sand between your toes at Lava Lava Beach Club at Waikoloa Beach Resort. Bikinis and boardshorts welcomed.

Accommodations: Vacation Rentals

title: Ka'ana Kitchen
teaser:
Sharing food with the people you love is a big part of traditional Hawaiian culture, and our fresh restaurant Ka’ana Kitchen offers a family-style experience. Discover dishes for breakfast, lunch and dinner made with ingredients from local farms, all reflecting the authentic flavors of the island.  
  
Family and friends make meals more meaningful, so grab your favorite humans and share farm-to-table cuisine that has been expertly prepared to stimulate your sense of adventure. Centered around a Hibachi grill, our new Maui restaurant is an exciting setting for sampling the local fare.  
  
We bring you the best of the island from local farmers, foragers and locavores, and we procure many of our ingredients exclusively from Ka’ana Farm and its neighbors. Let loose your taste buds and explore the adventures that await you at Ka’ana Kitchen.

title: Lehua Lounge
teaser:
Named after Hawaii’s brilliant red Lehua blossom, this elegant island lounge is nestled among waterfalls and features handcrafted cocktails, gorgeous views of Mokapu Beach and small bites of farm-to-table cuisine.  
  
Revel in a moment of celebration and luxury at our waterfall lounge. Choose from an inspiring menu of artisan cocktails that are hand-infused with fresh fruit juices and created with authentic methods.  
  
With vibrant scenery and a sophisticated setting, Lehua Lounge provides the perfect place to watch the sunset, relax with friends and enjoy the laid-back island lifestyle. You’ll also find a menu of creative small bites for easy fine dining on Maui.

title: Mokapu Market
teaser:
Need a midnight snack, an afternoon gelato or bottle of wine for your beachside rendezvous? Head to Mokapu Market to supply all of your island adventures. Open 24/7, our Wailea store features an interesting selection of island-made items.  
  
Enjoy the island vibe and discover a host of light snacks, flat breads, prepared foods and locally sourced, native made fare. You’ll also find a tasty display of house-made gelato for a cool treat.  
  
Mokapu Market also offers a wide range of beverages to cool off on those hot Maui days. Choose from hand crafted soft drinks, excellent beers and a large variety of wines.

title: Greenwell Farms
teaser:
Greenwell Farms legacy began in 1850 when Henry Nicholas Greenwell first set foot on the fertile soil of rural Kona. In 1873 Austria awarded the Greenwell's a "Recognition Diploma" for their Kona coffee at the World’s Fair.   
  
Today, Greenwell Farms is situated in the heart of the Kona Coffee country adjacent to the ancestral home of Henry and Elizabeth, which is now occupied by the Kona Historical Society and Museum. The farm is managed by fourth generation Tom Greenwell. Greenwell Farms grows its own coffee, and operates its processing and visitor attractions on just under 100 acres of the most productive land in the Kona District. The company also purchases coffee cherry from over 400 select farmers from the Kona region, shipping worldwide.   
  
Greenwell Farms offers free farm tours continuously from 8:30am through 4:30pm Monday through Sunday and is located at 81-6581 Mamalahoa Highway in Kealakekua. Call 808-323-9616 for more information.

title: Bumbye Beach Bar
teaser:
Don’t rush to Bumbye Beach Bar. Set on the edge of our lagoon pool near Mokapu Beach, our Maui beach bar is a place where morning slowly drifts into the day.  
  
Indulge in the easy pace of “island time,” and take a moment to savor fresh extracted fruit juices, hot Maui coffee and tasty Hawaiian pastries and baked goods.  
  
Later as lunch arrives, you’ll find island-inspired bites and cool cocktails. Try dishes crafted with locally procured ingredients and influenced by the diverse ethnicities that shape modern Hawaiian culture.

title: Awili Spa and Salon
teaser: The salon features multiple ocean-facing manicure and pedicure stations with a full service hair salon menu featuring a luxury product line specific to Andaz Maui at Wailea.

title: Precious Hawaii
teaser:
Precious Hawaii is dedicated in offering an assortment of island keepsakes. We take pride in the merchandise that we market, carefully seeking the newest superior products that represent Hawaii. Products featured here are only a small sampling of what we offer. We offer top of the line products, as well as elegant Hawaiian Jewelry.  
​  
We have over 20 years of experience in providing creative ideas for every type of gift. Our committment is to present our customers with a large selection of high quality products, some of which are designed exclusively for Precious Hawaii.   
  
In addition to our full product line, we take pride in our Participatory Events. title: Iruka Hawaii Dolphin
teaser:
Based in Honolulu, Waikiki, and Waianae, on Oahu, and Kona on the island of Hawaii, we specialize in unforgettable tour boating experiences.  
  
Our dolphin swim and snorkel tours offer intimate encounters with these friendly creatures. Experience the wonders of Oahu with our selection of three unforgettable dolphin tours, designed to suit a range of travelers. If you're seeking adventure, hop aboard our fast-paced Zodiac raft, ideal for up-close encounters with deep-water dolphin species. For those looking to relax, our spacious, family-friendly catamaran offers a smooth ride on the ocean, complete with a 21-foot waterslide and a variety of water toys. Whether you prefer dolphin watching or diving in for a swim, the choice is yours!  
  
Our founder's journey began with a life-changing encounter—swimming with dolphins while five months pregnant. This profound moment led her to dedicate her life to sharing this experience with others, even adopting a last name that translates to "dolphin." Since 2008, our mission has been to connect people with the ocean and Hawaii’s incredible wildlife, fostering a deeper appreciation for conservation.  
  
We also offer Waikiki's Friday Night Fireworks aboard a cruise, tranquil sunset tours, Whale watching, and turtle snorkeling tours on Oahu.  
  
On the Big Island, our sunset or night manta ray snorkel dives allow an up close experience where these gentle giants glide gracefully beneath you.  
  
Each tour is carefully crafted to ensure an extraordinary ocean adventure, combining the thrill of discovery with the beauty of the Hawaiian seas.  
  
Having welcomed more than 400,000 guests and earned thousands of glowing 5-star reviews, we aim to make your time in Hawaii truly memorable, offering dolphin adventures suitable for all ages.  
  
Join us for a journey that will leave you with lifelong memories.

title: Hawaiʻi Symphony Orchestra

As the region’s premier orchestra, HSO showcases award-winning musicians, celebrated guest artists, and renowned conductors, offering a distinctive Pacific perspective on a rich and diverse repertoire.  
  
Each season, HSO presents more than 50 performances - including the Halekūlani Masterworks Series, HapaSymphony Series, Films in Concert Series, and the Sheraton Summer Music Festival - at iconic venues such as the Neal S. Blaisdell Concert Hall, Hawaiʻi Theatre Center, and Tom Moffatt Waikīkī Shell.   
  
Through concerts and educational programs reaching over 140,000 residents and 3,175 students annually, HSO is committed to making music accessible and meaningful for all.  
  
For more information, visit myhso.org and follow us on social media @hawaiisymphonyorchestra

title: Hawaiian Journey
teaser:
Come and embark on your Hawaiian Journey, like never before.  
  
The Polynesian Cultural Center continues to celebrate the opening of the visually stunning new media experience, Hawaiian Journey. This experience takes guests on a journey unlike anything offered, to rediscover Hawaii. Majestic mountains, roaring waterfalls, lush forests and imposing volcanoes – many only accessible by air – are all brought to life through astounding cinematography and customized special effects that tantalize the viewers’ senses.  
  
The visual effects are only half the story. The story is an epic tale, passed down from ancestors, that will give you a deeper understanding of how the people of Hawaii are connected to the 'aina (land).  
  
The Polynesian Cultural Center is open Monday through Saturday from 11:30am to 9pm. Closed Wednesdays and Sundays.  
  
Packages start at $69.95.  
  
For more information or reservations call 800-367-7060, or visit us at www.Polynesia.com

title: Dolphins and You
teaser:
Discover what more than 300,000 Dolphins and You guests have experienced: wild dolphin sightings in Hawai‘i, a memory of a lifetime!  
  
With optional transportation from Waikīkī or Ko Olina, our all-new 55-foot power boat departs from Oahu's pristine west coast, the natural home of Hawai‘i’s wild dolphins, set against the stunning Waianae Mountain Range.  
  
We begin the journey with an authentic Hawaiian chant, “E Ho Mai,” to bring good fortune to our voyage. Then, we cruise along the West Side in search of Hawaiian Spinner Dolphins. As the name suggests, these dolphins are known for their acrobatic spins and long, slender snouts.  
  
After watching the dolphins, we head to one of the area's premier snorkeling spots, Makua Beach. There, you'll snorkel among a wide variety of sea life, including Honu (Hawaiian green sea turtles), tropical fish, and occasionally manta rays, whales, or monk seals.  
  
Our crew will then invite you to enjoy water activities such as kayaking and paddleboarding. Or simply relax on our spacious two-deck boat with wraparound bow seating and take in the beauty of the ocean, the choice is yours.  
  
On the way back, you’ll be entertained by our amazing crew with an authentic hula performance. You might even get the chance to learn a few dance moves!  
  
Before returning to the harbor, enjoy a complimentary sandwich and your choice of water or lemonade. Choose from a turkey sandwich, bean-spinach veggie wrap, or peanut butter jelly sandwich. Additional beverages, including alcoholic options, are available for purchase.

title: Circle Island Tour
teaser:
The Circle Island Tour lets you travel through historical, scenic, and cultural highlights of Oahu - the comfortable, convenient way. Our island shuttle takes you along Kamehameha Hwy past Diamond Head where you can enjoy stunning ocean views at Black Point Lookout*. You then view Hanauma Bay Lookout*, which overlooks the magnificent protected bay full of colorful marine life.   
  
As you travel along, you will see the beautiful Makapu’u Lighthouse, and be enthralled by the towering cliffs of the beautiful Pali Lookout*, site of the last great battle of Oahu. You then head inland past Oahu’s famous pineapple fields, with a quick stop at the Dole Plantation* and up past the famous North Shore* where you can dig your toes into the warm sandy beach. Our friendly tour guide will provide a continual narration providing interesting information during your tour.  
  
The Circle Island Tour concludes with a memorable visit to the Polynesian Cultural Center, voted Hawaii’s #1 visitor attraction by USA Today. There you can explore our 6 island villages and exhibits representing the Polynesian Island cultures of Hawaii, Fiji, Aotearoa, Samoa, Tahiti, Marquesas, Tonga, and Easter Island.  
  
Our award-winning Ali’i Luau takes guests on a riveting trip to learn about Hawaii’s royalty while enjoying mouth-watering Kalua Pork along with other traditional Hawaiian food and entertainment.   
  
The day concludes with “Ha: Breath of Life," a stunning evening show featuring over 100 Polynesian performers, special effects, animation and surround sound. It is a Pacific isle saga of birth and death, love and family, tragedy and triumph. Don't miss this truly unforgettable experience!  
  
Tour Schedule:  
8:00a - Depart Waikiki  
8:00a-12:30p - 8-10 tour stops (10-15 minutes per stop)  
12:30p - Arrive at the Polynesian Cultural Center  
6:30p or 9:30p Return to Waikiki from Polynesian Cultural Center.   
  
Open Monday through Saturday 11 am to 9 pm. Closed Wednesdays and Sundays

The brewery’s lineup features a wide range of ales and lagers, including several brewed with a tropical twist inspired by the islands. Every beer brewed at its state-of-the-art Kailua-Kona facility stays right here in Hawaiʻi, none leaves the islands.  
  
Guests can enjoy Kona Brewing Hawaiʻi beers at bars and restaurants across the state, or visit one of its two pub locations: the original brewery pub on the Big Island and a second pub on Oʻahu. Both locations serve fresh, locally inspired dishes featuring island fish and produce, gourmet pizzas, sandwiches, pupus, salads, and more. Each pub also features an extensive retail shop with Kona Brewing Hawaiʻi apparel, glassware, and gifts. title: Hawaii Temple Visitors' Center
teaser:
A trip to Oahu’s North Shore is not complete without a visit to a notable landmark, the Laie Hawaii Temple of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. The peaceful grounds of this spiritual place offer an idyllic setting to explore.  
  
Often called the “Taj Mahal of the Pacific,” it was the first temple built outside of the continental US. It was dedicated in 1919 to serve members throughout the Pacific and has a ten-foot marble replica of Thorvaldsen’s “Christus” statue. Free trams depart from the Polynesian Cultural Center to tour Laie, the Temple, and the Brigham Young University-Hawaii campus.  
  
All are welcome to visit the Temple grounds, including its Visitors’ Center and Family History Center; but, only members of the Church may enter the temple.  
  
For more information about the Laie, Hawaii Temple, visit www.lds.org/locations/laie-hawaii-temple-visitors-center?lang=eng or visit www.Polynesia.com

title: Makana Charters and Tours
teaser:
Makana Charters is a Native Hawaiian-owned family business offering one of the most cultural NaPali Coast Boat tours on Kauaʻi. Our family’s history on Kauaʻi spans generations, with ancestral ties to the Nā Pali Coast dating back more than 200 years. Our business is proudly rooted in the legacy of Chiefess Amelia Keaweamahi, our family’s ancestor whose home once stood on the very property where our office is located today.Documented, nearly two centuries ago, our family welcomed and guided some of the first visitors and it's family to experience the breathtaking Nā Pali Coast, beginning a tradition of sharing Kauaʻi’s extraordinary beauty, history, and culture that continues through Makana Charters today.  
  
Departing from Port Allen and Kikiaola Small Boat Harbor, we offer unforgettable snorkeling adventures, sea cave exploration (ocean conditions permitting), dolphin watching, seasonal whale watching, sightseeing cruises, sunset tours, and private charters aboard our modern fleet. Our experienced local captains and crew share the stories, legends, and natural wonders of the Nā Pali Coast while providing a safe, comfortable, and personalized experience.  
  
At Makana Charters, our mission is to honor our family’s legacy by connecting every guest to the spectacular beauty, rich history, and living culture of Kauaʻi through genuine Hawaiian hospitality, authentic local knowledge, and exceptional service. We are proud to continue our family’s tradition of sharing one of the world’s most beautiful coastlines with visitors from around the globe.

PEARL HARBOR TOUR  
  
Come and experience the most popular attraction in Hawaii… Pearl Harbor and the USS Arizona Memorial!  
  
Welcoming over a million visitors each year, Pearl Harbor easily takes first place as Oahu’s “must see” attraction. Immerse yourself in history and learn about “the day that will live in infamy” as you enjoy one of the country’s historical treasures. You will enjoy panoramic views of Pearl Harbor, the Ko’olau Mountains, and the Pacific Fleet as you walk through interesting museums, speak to veterans that are among the handful of remaining survivors, watch the Pearl Harbor Documentary exclusive to the Memorial, and even have a chance to board the USS Bowfin Submarine.  
  
Perhaps the highlight of this experience is the boat ride taken over to the USS Arizona Memorial, the iconic white structure that has been built directly over the final resting place of the USS Arizona and the many crew that are entombed within. It is here at the memorial where you will witness the Black Tears of the Arizona, a seemingly never ending stream of oil that still seeps from the sunken battleship below.  
  
We will start our day bright and early providing convenient pickups in Waikiki. Then, after a quick stop at Leonard’s Bakery for a quick breakfast and taste of local culture, we will make our way out to Pearl Harbor. After enjoying the Pearl Harbor experience, we will drive through downtown Honolulu and take a trip over to the Punchbowl National Cemetery of the Pacific. Then it’s off to see the statue of King Kamehameha the Great before returning to Waikiki.  
  
HAWAIIAN MONARCHS TOUR  
  
Explore the halls the Kings and Queens of Hawaii once walked and see the past come to life at Bishop Museum! This "must-do" experience includes comfortable, round-trip transportation on our deluxe mini-bus from convenient pick-up locations in Waikiki.  
  
First stop – the statue of King Kamehameha the Great. Here our guide shares a brief history of Kamehameha I, how he conquered all the islands and united them under one rule and what he means to the Hawaiian People.  
  
Next we head to the State Capitol building where Guests are led through the rotunda and learn what the architecture represents. We are then greeted by the statue of Queen Liliu‘okalani at ?Iolani Palace where our guide will provide a traditional oli (chant), asking permission to enter the palace grounds. If permission is granted, guests will the experience the following:  
  
A 15 minute video that shares an overview history of the palace along with the  
overthrow of the Hawaiian Monarchy  
A 50 minute guided tour of ‘Iolani Palace and walk in the footsteps where our ali’i lived  
and entertained  
Hawai?i’s Crown Jewels  
The Throne Room  
The Famous ‘Blue Room’  
Following your palace tour is a local-style lunch at Bishop Museum! Next to the natural beauty of our island’s Bishop Museum, founded in 1889, features the world’s premier cultural collections from Hawai?i and the Pacific.  
  
Continuing the story at Bishop Museum Guests will be taken on a 50-minute guided tour of the Hawaiian Hall Complex galleries and experience these highlights:  
  
The Kahili Room – shares the cheifly heritage and showcases the grand kahili (feather standards) associated with Hawai?i’s monarchy  
The Picture Gallery which includes ali?i portraits and depictions of chiefly residences  
After a guided tour of Hawaiian Hall, guests may take time to explore through the galleries on their own.

Surround yourself with Jurassic mountains, waterfalls, plants, tropical flowers, turtles, and beaches on our famous Bus to North Shore.

title: Nature and You
teaser:
Join And You Creations on our Nature and You tour! Our experienced local guides will lead you through the Manoa Valley Rainforest to a towering 150-foot (45-meter) waterfall, Manoa Falls! This waterfall and its trail's location have been used in movies and television shows such as Jurassic Park and Lost.   
  
With transportation from Waikiki included, our hike begins at a trailhead in the middle of the island, surrounded by massive jungle trees and stunning colorful plant life. The entire trail is an experience. There are many hidden secrets and treasures to behold along the way, such as a bamboo forest and a natural tree arch.   
  
Enjoy the breathtaking and lush scenery of Hawaii while our guides share interesting Hawaiian cultural facts and history. Ask them to tell you the story of the mysterious Menehune, or ancient Hawaiian ‘elves’. See if you can spot them in the trees! And listen for the calls of native Hawaiian birds - some found nowhere else on earth. The trail can be somewhat muddy (it is a rainforest, after all), so be sure to bring comfortable shoes and a light jacket.   
  
At the end of this 45-minute hike, the trees clear to display the “valley of rainbows” and your reward: 150 feet of cascading fresh water! Bring a camera to capture the beauty for yourself.   
  
It’s all downhill from there, as you head back along the trail the way you came. Take the time to revisit your favorite sights along the trail and ask your guides any questions you might have.   
  
After the hike, you’re sure to have worked up an appetite. We’ll take you to Local Sandwich Shop for a healthy power lunch, where you can choose from pastrami, turkey or a veggie sandwich.  
  
After picking up lunch from the cafe, you will visit the Tantalus lookout where you can take in the scenery while enjoying your healthy meal.   
  
The trail is suitable for people of all ages and experience levels. Book your hiking experience into Hawaii’s wilderness today!

title: Anelakai Adventures
teaser: Anelakai Adventures offers guided Hawaiian Double Hull Canoe, Night Manta Ray Double Hull Canoe, and Kayak and adventures on the Kona Coast of Big Island of Hawaii. Our goal is to share not only an amazing eco-friendly ocean experience with our guests, but also the history and culture of the island. Our Night Manta Ray Tour is our specialty, and we are the only company that gives you the option of getting in the water to view the Mantas, or enjoying a viewing experience from the comfort of your seat in the canoe. Our goal is to provide an eco-friendly, sustainable experience and leave no trace of our presence behind. We focus on small groups of no more than 6 and an experience like no other!!

title: Hula Kai
teaser:
Hula Kai offers premier Kona snorkel tours and adventure cruises along Hawaiʻi Island’s breathtaking Kona Coast. Departing from Keauhou Bay, Hula Kai is known for its fast, modern catamaran and small group experiences that combine adventure, comfort, and exceptional service.  
  
From vibrant daytime snorkeling along the South Kona coastline to the unforgettable Manta Ray Night Snorkel in Kona, Hula Kai delivers some of the most sought after ocean experiences on the Big Island. Guests explore crystal clear waters and thriving coral reefs, while cruising past dramatic lava rock cliffs, sea caves, and ancient shoreline formations that define this spectacular coast. While traveling along the coastline, guests may encounter larger marine mammals such as Hawaiian spinner dolphins, bottlenose dolphins, pilot whales, and during winter months, seasonal humpback whales.  
  
Designed for guests seeking a more intimate and adventure focused atmosphere, Hula Kai’s high speed vessel allows for flexible itineraries and access to prime snorkeling locations when ocean conditions allow. The boat’s sleek design offers shaded seating, easy water entry, and a smooth ride, creating an elevated Big Island snorkeling tour experience.  
  
Safety and professionalism are at the core of every Hula Kai excursion. Tours are led by experienced, lifeguard certified crew members who provide in water guidance, snorkel instruction, and marine life education to ensure guests feel confident and cared for throughout the journey.  
  
As part of the Fair Wind family of companies, Hula Kai shares a deep commitment to ocean stewardship and responsible tourism. The team promotes reef safe practices, respectful wildlife viewing, and sustainable operations that help protect Hawaiʻi’s fragile marine ecosystems. Every tour is guided by the belief that the ocean should be explored with care and preserved for future generations.  
  
Whether snorkeling vibrant reefs by day or experiencing the wonder of manta rays after sunset, Hula Kai offers an unforgettable Kona ocean adventure rooted in expertise, environmental responsibility, and the spirit of aloha.

Honolulu Cookie Company has grown to 14 retail locations. Most of our stores are located on Oahu, including several in the iconic Waikiki area and Ala Moana Shopping Center. title: Hawaii Wildlife Center
teaser:
The Hawai‘i Wildlife Center (HWC) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit and the first organization of its kind to provide state-of-the-art care and rehabilitation for native birds and bats as well as comprehensive wildlife rescue training and public education and outreach programs. HWC is a professional organization that focuses on treating and rehabilitating sick, injured and oiled native wildlife for release back into the wild and engaging the public in wildlife conservation efforts.  
  
The facility's public area features a science and discovery center and retail store. Public hours are Tuesday through Saturday, 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. Admission to the Ho‘opulama Science and Discovery Center is free. Donations are welcome. title: Kauai Safaris
teaser:
Enjoy an open air immersive experience unlike anything else. On the Kauai Rum Safari you’ll be taken around our lush plantation where we’ll show you exotic plants, our fruit and vegetable orchards, and many more beautiful sites. You’ll learn about the history of Rum in Hawaii and why Koloa Rum is so good, all before your first rum tasting.  
  
Once you’ve experienced the abundant land of our Kilohana Plantation, the next part of the safari tour is where we head to the jungle bungalow to have the first rum tasting. You’ll learn what makes our Mai Tai’s the very best (hint- it’s premium local rum). Interact and get to know other guest on tour and ask your guides any questions about rum and mixology, all while being surrounded by one of the serene tropical forests of Kauai.  
  
You'll continue your adventure by visiting new sites of the 105 acre plantation. Kilohana is home to over 70 wild pigs who you’ll be able to feed and interact with on the way to the next tasting. At the reflective pond, we’ll head into our Loi Lanai with a luscious backdrop to enjoy the next cocktail. For this tasting we use local fruits and herbs directly from the plantation to mix a delicious farm to glass cocktail. Let's have rum!

Paniolo Greens features spacious one- and two-bedroom tropical resort suites that comfortably sleep four to eight guests and range from 1,000 - 1,400 square feet. The “Big Island” of Hawaii is just that: the biggest in the island chain, and home to one of the largest volcanoes on the planet. This means much of what makes Hawaii so special is right outside your door, from the deep blue waters of the Pacific and its endless adventures, to lush rainforests and otherworldly lava flows. title: Polynesian Adventure
teaser:
Polynesian Adventure Tours, LLC (Poly Ad) was established on Oahu by Bob George and Don Brown in 1977. The company began with the innovative idea that utilized drivers as both narrators and guides. Poly Ad’s Maui operation opened in 1987, and shortly after the business was expanded to the Big Island and Kauai. Norwegian Cruise Line acquired Poly Ad in 2004 in order to service its shore excursion requirements throughout its port calls state-wide.   
  
Today, Poly Ad provides the best tour and transportation services in the Hawaiian Islands, offering visitors truly unique and memorable experiences. With fleets on the four major Hawaiian Islands, Poly Ad is ready to service groups looking to visit all of the islands during their stay. Every island is a unique experience waiting to be explored. Our charter department specializes in custom charters to must-see-sites and even to locations off the beaten-path. Our charter services include airport transfers, baggage services, greeting services and regularly scheduled sightseeing tours.   
  
On Oahu, we have the best selection of Pearl Harbor sightseeing tours that range from comprehensive all day tours to combo tours which include Honolulu’s most famous locales. Our guests explore the source of creation on the Big Island of Hawaii at Volcanoes National Park where they stroll through an ancient lava tube and observe Halemaumau Crater with its billowing steam cloud. On Kauai, the Garden Isle, guests marvel at the steep valleys of the Waimea Canyon and visit Koke'e Valley. The Movie Adventure tour visits the film locations of many Hollywood Blockbusters. On Maui, Poly Ad offers three tours showcasing majestic Haleakala – at sunrise, sunset and a Best of Hawaii combo tour that includes central Maui.  
  
Luau Kalamaku, a truly Hawaiian experience on the island of Kauai operates under Poly Ad’s management. The theatrical luau held on Tuesday, Thursday and Friday evenings at historic Kilohana Plantation, features a captivating theatrical performance, a delicious buffet of local favorites and so much more!

Through innovative programs and initiatives, STAH has pioneered an approach that champions the importance and benefits of sustainable tourism in Hawaii. Our work spans educating diverse audiences about sustainable tourism's benefits, advocating for eco-friendly practices within the tourism industry, and serving as the crucial connection point between community-driven conservation efforts. We believe that a diverse and sustainable tourism industry can safeguard Hawaii's unique charm and natural beauty for generations to come.

If you know you’ll be joining us, please don't hesitate to plan ahead; reservations can be booked up to 90 days in advance. If you’re in the area or on a scenic drive, like the road to Hana, please stop in! We would love to host you, with or without a reservation. You can shop our tasting room retail boutique without a reservation or being seated as a walk-in.  
  
We offer tasting flights, wines by the glass, wine cocktails, and light food fare that can be ordered as desired from our menu. The King's Cottage is not a "set tasting experience;" rather, each guest will order ala carte, or as they please, from our varied menu. We feature wines under the Ulupalakua Vineyards label, cultivated in our vineyard, just 1 mile down the road. We also specialize in traditional-method sparkling wines and wines made from 100% Maui Gold pineapples.  
  
We offer a seated experience. There is no longer stand at the bar tasting or service.

title: Kaanapali Kai Golf Course
teaser:
The Ka'anapali Golf Courses lie on the west side of Maui and in the heart of the Ka'anapali Beach Resort. With over 3 miles of golden sand, 11 different luxury hotel and condominium accommodations, 40 restaurants and three world-class spas, you can find all you need for your vacation, whether its action and adventure or relaxation and shopping, within walking distance.  
  
The Ka'anapali Kai Course was redesigned by golf course architect, Robin Nelson who has worked on over 40 courses across the state. The course combines narrow fairways with subtle greens and places a premium on ball placement off the tee and approach to the smaller greens. With four sets of tees, this course allows for challenge and fun from all levels of play. This course focuses on strategy of your round, not necessarily distance or strength, which is why this course is enjoyed by both the beginner and avid golfer.  
  
At 6,400 yards, the par 70 Ka’anapali Kai Golf Course is a more forgiving golf course with subtle, undulating greens that accommodates all levels of play. The land on which Ka’anapali Golf Courses was founded, originally housed a sugar cane plantation. The Kai course is landscaped with native flowers along the trails like the hibiscus, bougainvillea and plumeria, as well as the Norfolk Pines and coconut trees that border many fairways.  
  
Bring a junior golfer ages 7 -12 for only $25! The Kai Course is a course you can play 3-4 times and get a different experience each time. Nelson’s re-design rewards those who can “think” their way around the course and challenges those that get greedy around the greens with his huge bunkering!  
  
Join us daily on Maui's only 9-hole FootGolf layout where you combine soccer and golf - great for all ages and skill levels. Kick times required in advance. Call 808.661.3691 for rates and availability.  
  
The Resort & Golf Shop includes an abundance of Ka'anapali resort and golf apparel; from beach blankets and gift items to traditional logo apparel and aloha shirts, you’ll find something original and unique to take home with you to remember your vacation at Ka'anapali. Or, shop the online Pro Shop at www.kaanapaligolfcourses.com/store. Come discover why Ka'anapali is, where the world comes to play!

teaser:

title: Cane & Canoe
teaser:
With mesmerizing Kapalua Bay as its backdrop, Cane & Canoe offers its guests a window into the Hawaiian soul – both past and present. Here, in this historically rich locale, locals and travelers come together, savoring creative, modern cuisine that celebrates Hawaii’s diverse cultural influences while showcasing its freshest, locally sourced ingredients.  
  
Cane & Canoe’s architecture is reminiscent of a traditional Hawaiian canoe house, representing a community gathering place, where locals and artisans would socialize, make sails, shave wood and weave baskets. As such, the restaurant’s interiors honor the Hawaiian culture with a comfortable, communal atmosphere rich in wood scrollwork, woven textures and vibrant floral touches. This homage to the past is captivatingly juxtaposed with the gifts of modern luxury, offering clean lines, sophisticated furnishings and most importantly, a contemporary approach to cuisine. The menu at our restaurant in Maui is modern Hawaiian – reflecting the islands’ multicultural heritage. With a breathtaking oceanfront location, seafood naturally plays a central role, comprised of the freshest catches available. Produce is also locally sourced, whenever possible. And the wine program, overseen by the expertise of highly educated sommeliers, is one of the finest in the islands.  
  
Cane & Canoe is a setting where locals always feel as welcome as travelers. Where the ambiance and food honor the Hawaii of the past and present, along with its diverse cultural influences. And where authentic partnerships renew and strengthen ties between all who visit and live in this truly remarkable corner of the world.

title: Grand Wailea
teaser:
Discover a retreat shaped by nature and culture at Grand Wailea Maui, A Waldorf Astoria Resort. Fronted by the stunning Wailea Beach and surrounded by 40 acres of lush tropical landscape, our newly enhanced resort offers a tropical oceanfront paradise that embodies balance at every turn. Recent enhancements from our multi-faceted revitalization bring a fresh, modern interpretation of Hawai‘i to the resort - all while retaining the unique character and rich heritage that distinguish Grand Wailea as Maui’s premier luxury beachfront destination.   
  
ACCOMMODATIONS  
Experience our newly enhanced accommodations including 795 guest rooms inclusive of 58 suites featuring generous layouts starting at 640 sq. ft. and all offering lush tropical or ocean views and private lanais. Situated above the heart of the resort is Napua, offering 100 rooms and suites in a private tower featuring dedicated personal concierge services and world-class amenities. Adjacent to our resort are Ho‘olei Villas at Grand Wailea, the quintessential Maui residential experience. These spacious and private luxury villas blend the finest residential finishes with full access to the resort’s amenities.  
  
DINING  
From freshly made tacos to gourmet wood-oven pizzas and a daily breakfast buffet, our resort has a variety of culinary offerings to please every palate, including 5 bars and 9 diverse dining options, plus a traditional Hawaiian experience at their spectacular lūʻau. Our expert culinary team combines locally sourced ingredients—including organic produce grown on our own grounds—with inventive takes on the traditional flavors of Hawaiian cuisine to create unforgettable dining experiences rooted in the very essence of the ‘āina (land) we call home.  
  
AMENITIES & ACTIVITIES  
Aloha and e komo mai (welcome) to our Maui paradise. We invite you to experience not only the soaring beauty of our island home, but also the welcoming hospitality of its people and the timeless culture and traditions it maintains to this day.  
  
• Grand Lūʻau  
• Cultural Classes  
• Beach Yoga  
• Garden Tour  
• Outrigger Canoe Tour  
• Astrology Reading  
  
MEETINGS & INCENTIVES  
Whether your guests are gathering for work or play, Grand Wailea offers the ultimate Maui experience. Plan a meeting or event with the Pacific Ocean as the backdrop at our breathtaking Molokini Garden or our elegant Haleakalā Ballroom—or any of our other unique outdoor and indoor venues. Before and after your event, your guests can immerse themselves in the best of island life, from a quick dip in our two extraordinary pools to all-day excursions up and over volcanic peaks—the options are boundless. Invite your guests to cap things off with a stay in one of our spacious rooms, suites, or villas to bring each day to a perfect end.  
  
SPA & WELLNESS  
Kilolani Spa is a fully reimagined wellness destination at Grand Wailea that merges timeless Hawaiian principles and practices with advanced wellness techniques and technologies. Kilolani Spa’s varied indoor and outdoor spaces provide a range of communal and private settings for its signature wellness experiences and rituals for individual guests, couples, and groups.  
  
Honoring the Kilolani, the stargazers of ancient Hawaiʻi who looked to the skies to navigate their course, the Kilolani Spa experience reflects the tranquility, peace, and stillness of the sky in tune with the natural currents of the world. We invite you to tap into the timeless wisdom of Hawaiian culture, the grounding energy of nature, and the expansiveness of the celestial realm to chart your own course toward well-being.  
  
From beach yoga to traditional Hawaiian cleansing ceremonies, Grand Wailea's robust menu of movement and wellness activities invite you to connect with the natural beauty, soul, and spirit of Maui.

title: Island And You
teaser:
Island and You offers guests the ultimate local experience of Oʻahu in just one day.  
Visit historical sites filled with sacred energy (mana), learn about ancient Hawaiian culture, and shop for the perfect souvenir as you travel around the island. Most importantly, come hungry. Nearly all of the 10 stops on this Oʻahu food tour include authentic Hawaiian treats and meals.  
  
Here is a list of all stops:  
  
Treasures and You  
Leonard's Malasadas  
Halona Blowhole Lookout  
Makapu'u Lookout  
Tropical Farms Macadamia Nut Farm  
Kualoa Regional Park   
Tanaka’s Garlic Shrimp  
Kahuku Land Farm  
North Shore Beaches (pass by)  
Pua'ena Point Beach Park  
Haleiwa Town  
  
With transportation from Waikiki included, our circle-island tour begins with a stop at Treasures and You, where you’ll have a chance to use the restroom before the journey, enjoy some tasty local snacks, and browse for unique souvenirs.  
  
Next, we head to the east side of Oʻahu for a delicious treat from Leonard’s Malasadas, a beloved local favorite. After that, we visit the stunning Halona Blowhole Lookout, where you can take in awe-inspiring views of Oʻahu’s Windward coastline and shimmering turquoise waters. As we continue past Makapuʻu Lookout, enjoy the majestic views of the Koʻolau Mountain Range as we head to our next destination.  
  
Our next stop is the Macadamia Nut Farm. See how they harvest these healthy snacks and sample the island’s freshest macadamia nuts and coffee. Visit the gift shop for the perfect easy souvenir to take home!  
  
Next, see one of the island’s most iconic views at Kualoa Beach Park. The famous Mokoli’i island lies just off the coast. Young Hawaiian chiefs used to practice for their roles in this sacred space during ancient times. And behind the park, the steep, ridge-lined Ko’olau cliffs shoot up into the sky for a panoramic view! After the fun in the sun at this energy-filled stop - you guessed it - we’re ready for more food!  
  
After soaking in the scenery, it’s time for more food. Enjoy a flavorful plate of Kahuku-style garlic shrimp at Tanaka’s in Kahuku, followed by a sweet snack of banana turon from the nearby Kahuku Land Farm.  
  
Next, we’ll take you to a popular location to spot the Honu, or Hawaiian sea turtle. These gentle creatures often come ashore to sunbathe. We’ll observe them respectfully from a distance, as they are federally protected.  
  
To finish off the day, we visit the historic surf town of Haleiwa, where you can stroll through local shops, explore art galleries, and cool off with a refreshing treat from Matsumoto Shave Ice, a North Shore favorite.  
  
Oʻahu is rich with unforgettable experiences. Don’t miss out! Make the most of your time in Hawaiʻi and take a day to see, taste, and feel it all with Island and You.  
  
Please note the following  
*Tour schedule is subject to change due to unexpected weather, traffic or other various circumstances  
*We may view certain locations from the bus rather than stopping depending on tour conditions and guest preferences  
*Minimum bookings of 4 guests per tour needed. If the minimum is not met, the tour is subject to be re-scheduled or refunded

Amenities include three swimming pools, an ocean-fed snorkeling Lagoon Beach, waterfalls and waterways, locally-inspired treatments at Kohala Spa, and a wide variety of dining outlets that include Legends of Hawaiʻi Luʻau, Kamuela Provision Company featuring panoramic sunset dining over the Pacific Ocean, Kona Tap Room, offering craft brews from Kona Brewing Company; and a Museum Walkway with 1,800 unique art pieces.   
  
Adventures within the surrounding Waikoloa Beach Resort range from two championship golf courses to world-class shopping.   
  
Hilton Waikoloa Village is a gateway to the Island of Hawaiʻi, engaging travelers in the area's rich history through such interactive activities as hula and ukulele lessons and is the perfect starting point for the exploration of island attractions including active volcanoes, snow-capped mountains, lush valleys, breathtaking waterfalls, colorful beaches and deep culture, embodying the Island’s Aloha Spirit.

title: Ka Moana Luau
teaser:
Join our ʻOhana for an exciting evening under the stars as we take you on a voyage across Ka Moana (the ocean). Bringing you a new & improved Luau experience in 2023 with the same award-winning show at Aloha Tower, a new, convenient location with tons of awesome upgrades!  
  
Ka Moana Luau takes guests on a voyage through Polynesia with dances, chants and activities from across the Pacific. Participate in interactive cultural activities before the show like lei-making, hula lessons, headband weaving & more! Feast on an island-inspired farm-to-table luau dinner complete with seasonal fruit, poke, lomi lomi and Kalua Pig.

title: Temptation Tours
teaser: Award-Winning Temptation Tours-Maui's only fleet of custom built 8 passenger Luxury Limo-Vans. Sightseeing top natural locales. title: Volcano Winery
teaser: Volcano Winery is home to some of the most unique wines produced anywhere in the world. Tucked between the two majestic volcanoes Mauna Loa and Kilauea, we are one of the islands best- kept secrets and are quickly becoming a favorite stop for visitors around the world. The Big Islands only winery has been producing award-winning wine since 1993. Visitors are welcomed with Aloha into our quaint and cozy tasting room, which is flanked by two koa wood wine bars and surrounded by gifts for the wine aficionado. We offer wine tasting of all eight of our wines, including Gold medal winner Symphony Mele and our signature Macadamia Nut Honey Wine. Our wines are only available in the Hawaiian Islands, so you dont want to miss us. Come as you are for a taste of Hawaiis finest wines! Estate tea tasting available. Open everyday from 10-5:30 (Closed Christmas day). 2 miles from Hawaii Volcanoes National Park. For more information, visit us at www.volcanowinery.com or call (808) 967-7772.

title: Villas By the Cove
teaser:
Experience an older Hawaiian style charm with a modern twist at Villas By The Cove - a newly renovated boutique vacation rental estate that blends its Original 1940's Plantation Style Charm with a Refined Contemporary Design. Inspired by the tropical Maui landscape and historic surf culture, the property front gate is located 30 steps from sandy beaches and is directly across the street from The Cove Beach Park, Maui’s popular surf spot where guests can take surf lessons and mingle with locals.  
  
The complete redesign of the 1940s-era property has transformed this romantic property mixing art, a variety of local woods, glass and natural sunlight, that quite simply, just make you feel good. Located within 30 steps from sandy beaches on the desirable oceanfront Ili'ili Road, Villas By The Cove is a modern estate offering nine Villas Suites, a three bedroom Plantation Beach House, a swimming pool and events pavilion surrounded by lush, manicured landscaping, plumeria, palm and fruit trees.  
  
Each of the nine Villa Suites offer 600 to 800 square feet of luxurious accommodations and feature ocean and garden views. Each Villa Suite has a fully equipped kitchen, a comfortable king bed, a living room with a full size pullout couch, air conditioning, high speed wifi, a full bathroom with a spacious walk-in shower, a covered lanai and private gated parking.  
  
Personifying Kihei’s laid back beach-town community, we provide oversized beach towels, 2 boogie boards, 2 beach chairs, one beach umbrella, and one beach cooler in each of the nine villas for your sun-filled days at the white sandy beaches across the street. Enjoy privacy on this gated estate that's surrounded with lush, tropical landscaping and mango and palm trees.  
  
Ideal for weddings groups, yoga retreats, family reunions and large travel group vacations, the Villas By The Cove Estate offers an outdoor communal gathering/dining area on a flat grassy lawn shaded under a mango tree and an 800 square foot events pavilion. We can provide up to 6 complimentary event tables and 30 event chairs.  
  
All guests have access to our complimentary Private Concierge service to assist with arranging private chefs/caterers and restaurant reservations. Our Concierge can also arrange a variety of group activities such as luau's, snorkel boat tours, whale watching tours, helicopter rides, Zipline tours and bike rides down the Haleakala Crater. Special accommodations such as pre-arrival grocery service, in-residence spa services, and lei greetings are also available.  
  
Conveniently located on a small oceanfront side street across the street from the beach, Villas By The Cove is within walking distance to restaurants, food trucks, shops, nightlife, cafes, farmer's markets and supermarkets. The Cove Beach Park and a secret beach is directly across the street, about 30 steps from the property front gate. Charley Young Beach - a white sandy beach ideal for sun bathing, swimming, surfing, snorkeling, diving, stand up paddle boarding and kayaking is less than a minute walk from each villa.  
  
Our guests enjoy their sun-filled days at the beach across the street, relax on their private lanai's under the mango trees, eat at nearby restaurants and food trucks, play tennis, beach volleyball or picnic in the neighboring Kalama Park. Families with children can enjoy Kalama Park’s jumbo playground, skate board park, outdoor roller skating rink, tennis courts, basketball courts, batting cages and running paths. Surf schools, bicycle and scooter rentals, spa treatments and a farmer’s market are just around the corner.

title: Aston at Poipu Kai
teaser: Aston at Poipu Kai offers a quintessential tropical getaway. Located in Poipu on the southern coast of Kauai, the resort is comprised of 5 condominium communities spread out on 70 acres of lush landscaping. Each community has its own pool and features accommodations ranging from multi-room suites to 4-bedroom private homes. Onsite amenities include barbecue grills, tennis courts, a restaurant/sports bar, and a jogging path that leads to the beachfront. A convenient home base, the property’s location is accessible to many nearby attractions. Enjoy hiking, golfing, and dining at local eateries.
